title: Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x)
description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

As Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x), you won't just be booking booths and ordering giveaways. You'll shape how exmox shows up at the industry's most important conferences, in the press and for our own team, deciding where we go, what we do there and how we make it count, turning events into moments that partners, talent and the industry remember. And 2027 starts big: the move of our Hamburg HQ to Mönckebergstraße and the opening of our Berlin office are yours to make unforgettable. 

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you bring taste, pace and a real feel for the mobile and tech scene, let's talk.

In this role you will:

- Industry Events & Conferences: Plan and deliver exmox's presence at the conferences that matter in mobile gaming and adtech, from booths and speaking slots to side events and partner dinners, and help decide where we show up and where we skip.

- Own Formats: Create events that are distinctly exmox, the kind partners make time for, and grow them into formats that come back year after year.

- Office Openings: Lead the opening of our new Hamburg HQ and our Berlin office as brand moments, inside and outside the company.

- PR: Steer our PR partners day to day, set priorities and turn our events and milestones into stories worth covering.

- Internal Events & Merch: Shape the concept and experience of our internal events, with our Office Management team running the operations, and decide what merch and swag we produce, why and when, together with our Brand team.

- Budget & Commercial Impact: Manage event budgets and suppliers, work with Sales and Account Management to turn every event into partner meetings and opportunities, and measure what each event and campaign delivers, so every euro is spent on impact rather than attendance.

What You Bring

- Relevant Experience: You have 5 - 7 years of experience in event management, brand experience or experiential marketing, ideally in mobile gaming, adtech or another tech environment.

- Proven Delivery: You've planned and delivered conference presences, side events and corporate events end to end, including budgets, vendors and on-site execution. Experience working with PR agencies or media is a plus.

- Taste & Ideas: You know the difference between an event people attend and one they talk about, and you have the ideas to create the second kind.

- Hands-On & Organized: You move easily between the big picture and the details, and you stay calm when things change at the last minute.

- Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English and German, and willingness to travel internationally.

How We Win

- Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

- Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

- See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

- Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

- Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Teilzeit oder WerksstudentIn Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Bei grievy helfen wir Trauernden weltweit mit einer vertrauenswürdigen, barrierearmen und sofortigen digitalen Lösung für ihren Trauerprozess. Mit validierten Methoden, die auf neusten Erkenntnissen der Psychologie und aktuellen Wissenschaft basieren, lernen Trauernde in unserer App und Web-Lösung gesunde Strategien zum Umgang mit ihrer Trauer. Wir wollen das sich niemand mehr in der Trauer alleine fühlt!

grievy steht für die Enttabuisierung von Trauer in unserer Gesellschaft und die Unterstützung in den schwersten Zeiten des Lebens. Viele tausende Trauernde konnten wir bereits begleiten - doch wir wollen noch mehr!

Aufgaben

Aufgrund unseres starken Wachstums suchen wir ab sofort eine/n engagierte/n Werksstudent/in oder Teilzeitstelle (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Marketingteams. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

- Du schreibst liebevolle, high-performing Captions und Content-Formate.

- Du unterstützt unsere CEO in Personal Brand Aktivitäten über grievy auf LinkedIn und Instagram.

Du übernimmst vom ersten Tag an ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und bist Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und dynamischen Teams, mit dem du unsere Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mitgestaltest.

title: Content & Community Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Wir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Geschwindigkeit, Flexibilität und viel kreativer Gestaltungsraum – verbunden mit der Möglichkeit und Erwartung, diesen aktiv zu nutzen.

Während unser Head of Performance & Growth die Skalierung verantwortet, machst du unsere Marke jeden Tag erlebbar: Du entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle, unseren Content und unsere Community-Formate weiter – vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Reel, vom Community-Kommentar bis zum Event.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creator, UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und berichtest direkt an unsere Head of Performance & Growth.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

Content & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick.

Content-Produktion: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und setzt sie hands-on um – insbesondere Short-Form-Video. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig.

Creator & UGC: Du identifizierst relevante Creator, baust Beziehungen auf und entwickelst ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus UGC-Creator, Freelancer und Partner, das unsere Marke langfristig voranbringt.

Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken.

Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partner-/Location-Auswahl bis zur Durchführung und Nachbereitung.

Launch-Support: Für unsere Kollektions-Launches entwickelst du organische Content- und Community-Ideen und verzahnst sie eng mit unseren Paid-Aktivitäten.

Analytics & Reporting: Du behältst relevante KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Community-Wachstum im Blick, erkennst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus konkrete Learnings und neue Content-Ideen ab.

Was du mitbringst

Du fühlst dich auf Social Media zu Hause und verstehst, warum Content funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Dabei ist uns dein Gespür für Content, Community und relevante KPIs wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren.

Idealerweise bringst du mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content oder Community mit – zum Beispiel aus einer Festanstellung, Werkstudentätigkeit, einem Praktikum, Freelance-Projekten oder eigenen Social-Media-Projekten.

Du bist hands-on: Du kannst Content von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik, Trends und die unterschiedlichen Logiken von Instagram, TikTok & Co.

Du verstehst Content Creation: Du kannst selbst drehen und schneiden und weißt gleichzeitig, wann Creator, UGC oder Freelancer die bessere Lösung sind. Du musst dabei nicht zwingend selbst vor der Kamera stehen – wichtiger ist, dass du gute Inhalte erkennst, entwickeln und umsetzen kannst.

Du kannst Community: Du verstehst, wie aus Reichweite Interaktion und aus Interaktion echte Bindung entsteht. Wenn du bereits eine Community oder eigene Social-Media-Kanäle aufgebaut hast, umso besser.

Du schreibst markensicher: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und triffst den Ton einer modernen Lifestyle-Brand.

Du denkst in Zahlen: Reichweite, Engagement Rate, Watch Time oder Community-Wachstum sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen. Du nutzt sie, um zu verstehen, was funktioniert und was wir beim nächsten Mal besser machen können.

Du setzt um: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder einzelne Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du bringst Ideen ein, probierst Dinge aus, lernst daraus und treibst deine Themen eigenständig voran.

Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass du schon jede dieser Aufgaben perfekt beherrschst. Wenn du Social Media verstehst, Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, schnell lernst und HeyHoney gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln möchtest, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Was wir dir bieten

Content, Community und Events sind bei uns bewusst noch nicht auserzählt. Das bedeutet: Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System, sondern kannst aktiv mitgestalten.

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Ein kleines, schnelles Team, kurze Wege und die Freiheit, Strukturen, Formate und Ideen selbst mit aufzubauen – im direkten Sparring mit unserer Head of Performance & Growth.

Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind Remote-First und offen für unterschiedliche Modelle – Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder Werkstudent. Entscheidend sind für uns dein Beitrag, deine Fähigkeiten und der messbare Output, nicht deine Anwesenheit im Büro.

Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die Rolle kann mit dir wachsen. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zeigst, dass deine Ideen funktionieren, bekommst du bei uns den Raum dafür.

Miteinander, das zur Marke passt: Wir sind ein herzliches, offenes Team und leben den HeyHoney-Spirit auch intern – mit Augenhöhe, Vertrauen und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander, das auch über die Distanz trägt.

Lust, HeyHoney mit aufzubauen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Zeig uns dabei gerne mehr als deinen Lebenslauf: Welche Accounts, Reels, TikToks oder Formate findest du richtig gut? Was hast du selbst schon umgesetzt? Welche Community oder welchen Kanal hast du mitentwickelt?

Links zu eigenen Accounts, Content-Beispielen, UGC-Projekten oder Events sind sehr willkommen. Auch eigene Projekte zählen für uns – es muss nicht alles aus einer klassischen Festanstellung stammen.

Bei HeyHoney zählt, was du kannst und einbringst – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht und geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität und Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung, einer Behinderung oder deiner sozialen Herkunft. Wir bewerten Bewerbungen ausschließlich nach fachlicher Eignung und freuen uns über jede Perspektive, die unser Team vielfältiger macht.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description:
Who We Are 

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com . 

Über Verve Retail Media 

Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit einer AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen hinweg. Zudem haben wir Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billion ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr.

Die Rolle in einem Satz 

Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.

Was du tust 

- Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads

- Bedarfs- und Entscheiderqualifizierung im Erstgespräch

- Buchung qualifizierter Termine für die Account Executives im definierten Zielslot

- Saubere Übergabe inkl. Pain Points, Kontext und Entscheidungsstruktur

- Strukturierte Vorbereitung jedes Calls — Vorbereitung ist 80 % des Erfolgs

Dein Setup 

- Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Leads — nicht mit Cold-Listen

- Salesforce als CRM, Aircall für die Telefonie, LLM-gestützte Recherche-Workflows

- Klares Sales-Playbook mit Pitch-, Einwand- und Übergabe-Logik

- Regelmäßige 1:1-Coachings, Call-Reviews und Pipeline-Calls

Deine Aufgaben 

- Eigene Aktivitäts-Pipeline aufbauen, priorisieren und mit klaren KPIs (Calls/Tag, Termine/Tag, Show-Up-Rate) führen

- Recherche zu Kunden, Branchen und Standorten als Grundlage jedes Calls

- Pflege aller Aktivitäten und Opportunities in Salesforce

- Enge Abstimmung mit den Account Executives: Feedback zur Termin-Qualität, gemeinsame Iteration

- Aktives Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Pitches, Skripten und Workflows

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt 

- Bericht direkt an den Head of Regional Sales

- Du arbeitest im Team mit anderen SDRs sowie eng mit den Account Executives, an die du übergibst

- Klare Karriereperspektive: Aufstieg zum Account Executive bei nachgewiesener Performance

Dein Profil 

Diese Rolle ist bewusst auf Einsteiger und Quereinsteiger in den Sales zugeschnitten. Du passt, wenn du mindestens eines der folgenden Profile mitbringst:

- Erste Sales-Erfahrung: Du hast in einer SDR-, BDR-, Inside-Sales-, Outbound-Call-Center- oder Telefonvertriebsrolle gearbeitet und willst auf das nächste Level.

- Quereinstieg mit Telefonaffinität: Du kommst aus Kundenservice, Retail, Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder einem anderen Umfeld mit viel Kundenkontakt und willst gezielt in den Sales wechseln.

Für beide Profile gilt:

- Du hast Spaß am Telefon, keine Scheu vor Erstansprache und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen

- Du arbeitest strukturiert, bereitest dich vor und nimmst KPIs ernst

- Du bist offen, coachable und willst täglich besser werden

- Du nutzt LLMs aktiv für Recherche und Vorbereitung, oder bist bereit, das schnell zu lernen

- Deutsch fließend auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (alle Calls auf Deutsch), Englisch von Vorteil

- Du willst nicht für immer SDR bleiben, der Aufstieg zum Account Executive ist dein Ziel

Warum diese Rolle 

Du steigst nicht in eine fertige Vertriebsmaschine ein. Du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf — und legst damit die Pipeline-Grundlage für unser komplettes Regional-Sales-Geschäft.

- Echter Karrierepfad: Bei nachgewiesener Performance Aufstieg zum Account Executive in 12–18 Monaten

- Warme Leads statt Cold-Calling-Liste

- KI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen

- Strukturiertes Onboarding und kontinuierliches Coaching

- Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Fixum + transparente Termin-Vergütung + ungedeckelte Commission

Wenn du Sales lernen willst, wo es ernst gemeint ist und wo gute Leistung sichtbar wird, ist das die richtige Rolle.

title: Web Engineer Intern
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES

What We Do 

Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.

WEB ENGINEER INTERN

What You'll Do 

We are looking for a Web Engineer Intern to join the Tools & Portals team within Epic Online Services. Tools & Portals builds the software, platforms, and digital experiences that enable Epic’s internal teams, player support operations, players, and external developers to work with and access Epic services more effectively. You will contribute to production systems across the full stack while gaining hands-on experience with modern web development, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted software development.

In this role, you will 

- Build full-stack features using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with guidance from the team

- Contribute to development of backend services and APIs using Next.js, NestJS, and Node.js 

- Learn and apply development practices for production infrastructure including AWS, Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines 

- Write, test, review, and deploy production code alongside experienced engineers 

- Learn and apply AI-assisted software development workflows throughout the software development lifecycle 

- Contribute to internal tools and developer-facing platforms used across Epic Games 

What we're looking for 

- Interest in full-stack web development and learning modern engineering technologies 

- Some familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or similar web technologies through coursework, projects, or previous experience 

- Eagerness to learn, ask questions, and contribute to solving well-defined engineering problems 

- Willingness to explore new technologies and codebases, seek support when needed, and incorporate feedback 

- Ability to work effectively with guidance, communicate questions and blockers, and incorporate feedback 

- Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work closely with engineers, product partners, external teams, and stakeholders 

- Understanding of defined requirements and willingness to ask clarifying questions when needed 

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including sharing progress and incorporating feedback 

- Interest in using AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of software development 

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers . This is going to be Epic! 

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! 

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

👋 Hi, I’m Manuele Maggi, Engineering Manager at Motorway. I’m looking for an Android

Engineer to join our Mobile Engineering group and help us build a best-in-class experience

for our Sellers.

This is a great opportunity to join a talented and supportive team, working alongside

engineers, product managers and designers to fundamentally change the way people sell

their car. You’ll contribute to meaningful features used by customers across the UK, develop

your technical skills and explore the latest tools and technologies—with AI increasingly

embedded in how we build and work.

About the role 

As an Android Engineer, you’ll take ownership of well-defined features and contribute

throughout the development lifecycle, from early ideas through to release and iteration.

Day-to-day, you’ll be:

- Collaborating with designers, product managers and other engineers to build high-quality customer experiences.

- Designing, building and shipping Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

- Contributing to the development of our in-house Server-Driven UI framework, helping us deliver features and dynamic experiences more quickly.

- Supporting and improving our mobile infrastructure, including CI/CD pipelines with

- GitHub Actions, Google Play deployment workflows and automated UI testing.

- Writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

- Participating in code reviews and technical discussions, learning from others while sharing your own ideas.

- Paying close attention to UI detail, accessibility and the overall app experience.

- Building an understanding of the backend systems and APIs that power our app.

- Monitoring released features and helping to resolve issues when they arise.

- Contributing to the engineering standards and practices used across the Mobile Engineering group.

About you 

- We’re looking for someone with:

- Commercial experience building Android applications.

- Good knowledge of Kotlin and modern Android development.

- Experience with Jetpack Compose, or an interest in developing your skills with it.

- An understanding of common mobile development principles, patterns and testing practices.

- Experience building and releasing features as part of a collaborative product team.

- The ability to write clear, maintainable and well-tested code.

- Good collaboration and communication skills.

- A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of your work.

- Curiosity and a genuine desire to continue learning and developing as an engineer.

You could be a great fit if 

- You’ve contributed to reusable components or modules.

- You enjoy working closely with product and design to solve customer problems.

- You’re comfortable owning features while asking for support when needed.

- You care about building polished, reliable and accessible mobile experiences.

- You’re interested in using modern technologies, including AI, to improve products and engineering workflows.

- You enjoy sharing ideas, receiving feedback and learning from experienced engineers.

Bonus 

- You don’t need to tick every box, but it would be helpful if:

- You have experience with Server-Driven UI.

- You have worked with A/B testing or experimentation.

- You have some exposure to CI/CD and automated mobile testing.

- You have integrated ML or AI-powered functionality into an app.

- You have experience or an interest in backend or full-stack development.

- You have experience taking a feature from an initial idea through to release.

Location 

Hybrid working, with two days a week in our London office and the remainder working from

home.

Our interview process 

- Qualifying Screen — 30 minutes

- Technical Interview — 60 minutes

- Soft Skills Interview — 60 minutes, onsite depending on the team

You can expect to hear back from us within a week of each interview stage. You’ll also have

the opportunity to speak with a Talent Partner throughout the process if you have any

questions or require any accommodations.

Benefits 

- We’ve got your back in life’s biggest moments—and the everyday ones too.

- Competitive salary

- Equity scheme—we all share in Motorway’s success

- 25 days’ holiday

- Flexible working, including two days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore

- Private medical insurance through Bupa

- Life assurance

- Pension scheme with a 5% employer contribution

- Enhanced family leave, including 26 weeks’ full pay for maternity or adoption leave

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

- EV leasing scheme

- Cycle to Work scheme

- Nursery salary-sacrifice scheme

- One paid volunteering day each year

title: Performance Engineer
description:
UK | Full-Time 

The Mission: Source.dev 

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) .

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. 

The Core Product: SourceFS 

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

- 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

- 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

- True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It 

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership :

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” 

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O 

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On 

- System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

- Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

- Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

- Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

- Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile: 

- The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. 

- Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

- Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.

- Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

- Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness

- Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

A Note on Our Search 

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev ? 

- AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

- Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

- Early-Stage Ownership : You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

- Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

- Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

title: Principal Solutions Architect, Professional Services
description:
About Docker 

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities 

Build and Scale the Professional Services Practice

- Drive alignment and decision-making across multiple stakeholders and teams without direct reporting lines.

- Translate field insights including enterprise integration patterns, IDP/SSO friction points, observability gaps, and AI deployment challenges into actionable product and services strategy, roadmap, and partner capabilities.

Qualifications 

Required 

- 7+ years as a Professional Services Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role at a SaaS/infrastructure company or consulting firm.

- Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying self-hosted and air-gapped deployment architectures: local image registries, offline toolchain configuration, network-isolated Kubernetes clusters, and compliance-driven infrastructure constraints common in regulated industries.

- Enterprise integration experience across Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD, LDAP/Active Directory) and federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, SSO), including RBAC design within complex, multi-tenant enterprise environments.

- Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its application to agentic AI toolchains including MCP server/client architecture, tool and resource orchestration, and secure containerized deployment patterns.

- Hands-on experience with AI/ML workflows, LLM deployment, and agentic AI architectures in enterprise environments with awareness of Docker's AI platform roadmap including AI agent containerization, model provenance, and AI supply chain security.

- Deep understanding of container and software supply chain security: Docker Hardened Images (DHI), Secure Supply Chain (SSC), SBOM generation, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, and runtime governance.

- Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills; able to lead executive-level architecture conversations and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Direct experience delivering high-quality services engagements that achieve customer value while meeting revenue and ARR growth targets within a revenue organization.

Bonus

- Consulting experience with Fortune 500 clients in highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, or government.

- Led AI security architecture engagements that addressed model provenance, artifact signing, and supply chain integrity for containerized AI workloads including secure MCP server deployment, tool and resource access controls, secrets management within agentic pipelines, and runtime isolation patterns for LLM-based applications.

What to Expect 

First 30 Days

One-Year Outlook

- Institutionalize continuous improvement by providing field feedback including enterprise integration patterns, deployment blockers, and observability gaps to the product team.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

Compensation & Equity 

EU: €119K – €170K + equity

Posting Information

- Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits 

- Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

title: Senior Technology Risk Analyst
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise. 

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com. 

Senior Technology Risk Analyst 

- Department: Data & Technology Solutions (DTS)

- Reports To: SVP Security and Compliance

- Location: [London/Hybrid 2 days a week in office]

- Position Type: Full-Time

Role Purpose 

The Senior Technology Risk Analyst is responsible for managing and continuously improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) across Data & Technology Solutions. You will ensure that security policies, controls, risks, exceptions, and governance processes are properly maintained, evidenced, reviewed, and acted upon.

Reporting to the SVP Security and Compliance, you will provide the operational backbone for security governance across DTS. This is a hands-on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) role. You will collaborate across security, product, engineering, infrastructure, architecture, legal, risk, compliance, and delivery teams to transform security governance into a dynamic, working management system rather than a static documentation exercise.

Key Responsibilities 

1. ISMS Ownership & Operation 

- Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of the DTS ISMS.

- Maintain the ISMS framework, documentation, control library, policies, standards, and procedures.

- Ensure the ISMS accurately reflects how DTS operates across products, platforms, infrastructure, data, and engineering.

- Support alignment with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA (where applicable), and wider WPP security requirements.

- Ensure ISMS artefacts are version-controlled, approved, reviewed, and communicated appropriately.

- Maintain clear evidence of security governance activity, control operation, risk treatment, and management reviews.

2. Policy Management & Control Governance 

- Own the lifecycle of DTS security and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.

- Coordinate policy reviews with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Technology stakeholders.

- Ensure policies are practical, clear, enforceable, and aligned with DTS's operating reality.

- Track policy exceptions, waivers, compensating controls, and review dates.

- Ensure policy changes are communicated and seamlessly embedded into operational processes.

3. Risk Review Board Operation 

- Establish and continuously run the DTS Risk Review Board .

- Define the Board’s cadence, agenda, inputs, outputs, attendees, and escalation routes.

- Prepare comprehensive risk packs, dashboards, decision logs, and action trackers.

- Ensure risks are presented clearly, consistently, and with appropriate supporting evidence.

- Track decisions, owners, due dates, mitigations, exceptions, and residual risks.

- Escalate risks exceeding agreed thresholds to the SVP Security and Compliance, DTS leadership, the CISO office, or other appropriate forums.

4. Risk Register Management 

- Own and maintain the central DTS security and compliance risk register.

- Capture, assess, categorise, and maintain security, compliance, privacy, operational resilience, third-party, and technology risks.

- Ensure all risks have clear descriptions, owners, likelihood/impact ratings, inherent risk scores, mitigations, residual risk scores, treatment plans, and target dates.

- Partner with risk owners to ensure mitigations are realistic, funded, and actively progressed.

- Track overdue risk actions and escalate insufficient progress.

- Produce regular risk reporting for DTS leadership and wider WPP governance forums.

5. Control Assurance & Evidence Management 

- Support ongoing assurance activity by ensuring controls are consistently evidenced, tested, and reviewed.

- Maintain control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, client assurance, internal audits, and other compliance needs.

- Coordinate evidence collection from Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Product, HR, Legal, and Enterprise Technology.

- Identify gaps between documented controls and actual operating practices, tracking remediation plans.

6. Compliance Support & Audit Readiness 

- Support DTS compliance obligations (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR-related controls, and client-specific requirements).

- Help prepare for internal/external audits, client reviews, security questionnaires, and due diligence exercises.

- Maintain an organized, always-ready evidence library and audit trail.

- Support management reviews required by ISO 27001 and other governance frameworks.

7. Exception, Waiver & Remediation Tracking 

- Manage the formal process for security exceptions, policy waivers, risk acceptances, and remediation plans.

- Ensure exceptions are documented, reviewed, approved, time-bound, and assigned to accountable owners.

- Track compensating controls, monitor residual risk, and manage the renewal/escalation of expired exceptions.

8. Third-Party & Supplier Risk Support 

- Help assess security and compliance risks associated with vendors, partners, tools, platforms, and managed services.

- Maintain supplier risk records and coordinate with Procurement, Legal, CISO, Enterprise Technology, and Product teams.

- Ensure third-party risk is appropriately integrated into the DTS risk register and Risk Review Board.

9. Security Governance Reporting 

- Produce clear, reliable, and actionable governance dashboards and reports for the SVP Security and Compliance and DTS leadership.

- Translate complex governance and technical data into clear business language, highlighting trends, overdue actions, and material risks.

10. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture 

- Foster a collaborative and practical security governance culture across DTS.

- Coach risk owners on how to describe, assess, treat, and monitor risks.

- Ensure risk processes support business delivery rather than becoming bureaucratic overhead.

Key Accountabilities 

The ISMS and Risk Officer will be directly accountable for:

- Effective operation, accuracy, and maintenance of the DTS Senior Technology Risk Analyst.

- Continuous, disciplined operation of the DTS Risk Review Board.

- Up-to-date, approved, and realistic security policies, standards, and control documentation.

- Structured tracking of risks, exceptions, waivers, and remediation plans.

- Audit-ready evidence management and reliable governance reporting to leadership.

Skills & Experience 

Required: 

- Proven experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, audit, or ISMS operation .

- Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001 and practical ISMS management.

- Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA , cloud security, SaaS platforms, and enterprise security controls.

- Experience maintaining risk registers, policy frameworks, control libraries, and audit evidence repositories.

- Experience running or supporting risk committees, governance forums, or control review boards.

- Excellent technical writing skills (policies, standards, risk statements, and governance reports).

- Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate technical issues into business risk/compliance language.

- Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a constructive yet persistent approach to driving action.

Preferred: 

- Experience operating within a complex, matrixed, enterprise environment is highly valued.

Leadership Expectations 

- Disciplined & Reliable: Bring structure, order, and high standards of documentation to risk and compliance processes.

- Pragmatic & Delivery-Aware: Build trust with technical teams by making governance useful, proportionate, and aligned with delivery.

- Proactive: Follow through persistently on actions, dates, and evidence, and escalate bottlenecks clearly.

- Collaborative: Support the SVP Security and Compliance in building a mature, transparent, and well-governed security function.

Success Measures 

- A current, well-maintained DTS ISMS with zero "reactive" compliance rushes.

- Security policies and standards reviewed, updated, and communicated on schedule.

- The Risk Review Board operating systematically with clear actions and high leadership engagement.

- DTS risk register actively used by leadership to drive risk-based decisions.

- Audit and certification evidence organized so there are "fewer surprises" during external audits and client reviews.

- Security governance fully embedded as a natural part of daily DTS operations.

description:

description:
Monster Jam is the world’s premier monster truck entertainment property, delivering unforgettable live events, iconic trucks, and family experiences to millions of fans around the globe. As the brand continues to expand across Europe, we are seeking a dynamic Franchise Manager to lead integrated growth initiatives spanning marketing, consumer products, retail partnerships, and toy/category development. 

The Senior Director, International Global Partnerships, will lead the strategic growth of the Monster Jam brand across key European markets through integrated franchise marketing, retail activation, consumer products expansion, and cross-functional partnership management. This role is responsible for building cohesive programs that drive brand awareness, increase toy and merchandise penetration, strengthen retailer relationships, and ultimately accelerate event attendance and ticket sales.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded brand builder with experience managing entertainment, toy, sports, family, or lifestyle franchises across multiple territories. This individual will work closely with the Monster Jam consumer products team, regional promoters, retail partners, regional licensees and the Spin Master toy organization to create coordinated campaigns that put Monster Jam products into the hands of consumers while amplifying engagement with the brand within all franchise touchpoints including the live event business.

Essential Functions 

Franchise & Brand Marketing

- Develop and execute the European franchise growth strategy for Monster Jam across key markets and retail channels.

- Lead integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, fan engagement, and affinity for the Monster Jam brand.

- Partner with regional event, marketing, and ticketing teams to align campaigns that drive attendance and revenue growth.

- Create scalable promotional programs that connect consumer products, retail activations, digital marketing, and live events.

- Identify market-specific opportunities to grow audience reach, including localized campaigns, partnerships, and experiential activations.

- Serve as a steward of the Monster Jam brand across all consumer-facing touchpoints.

Consumer Products & Licensing

- Support the expansion of the Monster Jam consumer products business throughout Europe.

- Identify opportunities for new product categories, retail exclusives, promotions, and licensing partnerships.

- Collaborate with internal licensing and consumer products stakeholders to maximize shelf presence and category performance.

- Analyze market trends, retail performance, and consumer insights to inform product and franchise strategies.

- Develop annual plans and commercial initiatives that support long-term franchise growth.

Retail Partnerships & Programs

- Build and manage strategic relationships with major European retailers and distribution partners.

- Develop retail marketing programs that elevate visibility, support product launches, and drive sell-through.

- Partner with retailers on seasonal campaigns, in-store activations, sweepstakes, promotions, and event tie-ins.

- Coordinate retailer-specific marketing assets, promotional calendars, and execution plans.

- Monitor retail performance metrics and identify opportunities to optimize programs and increase market penetration.

Spin Master Partnership Management

- Act as the primary liaison with the Spin Master toy team across Europe and North America for product development for regional needs.

- Partner closely on go-to-market planning, product launches, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives.

- Communicate regional market insights, fan trends, and retailer feedback to support product development and commercial planning.

- Drive initiatives that increase toy awareness, distribution, and consumer adoption across Europe.

- Champion the shared vision of placing a Monster Jam toy in every child’s hands to fuel broader franchise engagement and live event attendance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing, events, ticketing, licensing, finance, and operations, to ensure alignment across all franchise initiatives.

- Lead project timelines, campaign execution, and stakeholder communication across multiple markets and partners.

- Present business updates, market insights, and growth opportunities to senior leadership.

- Manage agency and external partner relationships where applicable.

Job Requirements 

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Entertainment Management, or related field.

- 5–8+ years of experience in franchise marketing, brand management, consumer products, licensing, retail marketing, or related fields.

- Experience working with entertainment, toy, sports, gaming, family, or lifestyle brands preferred.

- Strong understanding of European retail landscapes and consumer markets.

- Proven ability to manage cross-functional partnerships and external stakeholders.

- Experience collaborating with major retailers and consumer products organizations.

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business growth.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects across international markets in a fast-paced environment.

- Willingness to travel across Europe and internationally as needed.

Success Metrics

- Growth in Monster Jam brand awareness across European markets.

- Increased consumer products and toy sales performance.

- Expansion and effectiveness of retail partnerships and promotional programs.

- Measurable contribution to event attendance and ticket sales growth.

- Successful execution of integrated franchise marketing initiatives.

- Strengthened collaboration and strategic alignment with the Spin Master partnership team.

title: Principal Engineer, Platform
description:
Firmus Technologies 

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud 

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Platform to own the platform Firmus engineers build and release on, in public cloud and in our own data centres. Self-service and security come first: through one golden path, an engineer should be able to create a service, get an environment, and ship to production securely with minimal support. Everything you design must work across sites and scale to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Architecture and Decisions 

- Own the architecture of the engineering platform and its multi-site management plane, in public cloud and on premises. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it. 

- Design the platform around a repeatable scaling unit. Capacity grows in identical units, a failure stays inside one unit or site, and each site meets a defined standard before it carries the platform. 

- Decide how internal Kubernetes and hypervisor clusters are built, networked, upgraded, and recovered. Keep Kubernetes conformant and close to upstream releases, with upgrades that need no downtime. New sites come up from code and the site deployment kit, and recovery is tested regularly. 

- Decide how services are packaged, released, and promoted with progressive rollout, and how a failed release is rolled back and contained across sites. 

- Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes. 

Build and Evolve 

- Own engineer self-service with an API-first design. The CLI, automation, and any developer portal all use the same platform API. Treat every ticket to the platform team as a gap in self-service and close the most common ones first. 

- Keep a service catalogue in code, with an owner for every service and scorecards that show each team where its services stand against the golden path, production-readiness, and security standards. 

- Provide multi-cluster deployment for internal teams and the customer product: one pipeline to every region and data centre, the customer product isolated from internal workloads, and sites that keep running when the orchestrator is unreachable. 

- Let AI agents work on the delivery path under the same controls as engineers, with their own identity, least privilege, sandboxing, and a person approving every production change. 

Reliability, security, and cost 

- Set SLOs and error budgets for the platform and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first. 

- Lead the technical response to major incidents in the platform and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again. 

- Set the standard every change meets before it goes live: code review, acceptance tests, builds traceable from source to deploy, and the application security team's controls in every pipeline by default. 

- Provide secrets, certificates, and single sign-on as platform services, built to the security team's identity and secrets standard, with mutual TLS between services and credentials issued from code, short-lived, and rotated automatically. 

- Build continuous compliance for SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the platform, with controls written as policy in code, evidence collected automatically, and drift detected and corrected. 

- Automate patching without disruption and land urgent and embargoed security fixes within defined timelines. Nodes are replaced site by site from rebuilt images, within each service's disruption limits and with automatic rollback. 

- Own cost at the design level, including cloud spend, with one shared path for every team and site. 

Technical leadership 

- Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager. 

- Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design. 

- Own the technical interviews and assessments for platform engineers and hold every candidate to that bar. 

Partnership and communication 

- Shape the platform roadmap with product, infrastructure, network, and site-delivery leaders, and have the platform ready before each new region or data centre goes live. 

- Agree ownership in writing at each boundary with infrastructure, network, security, software, data and observability, and settle disagreements directly. 

- Represent the platform team in customer and auditor reviews of security, reliability, and compliance. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 10+ years in platform, infrastructure, or software engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way. 

- Has owned a golden path other engineers used to ship: infrastructure as code (such as Terraform or OpenTofu), CI/CD, and GitOps (such as Argo CD or Flux), with progressive rollout, rollback, artifact signing and provenance, and security gates in the pipeline. 

- Has run a platform as a product, with self-service through templates and a platform API or CLI that teams adopted, measured by adoption and delivery performance rather than uptime alone. 

- Has built, upgraded, and recovered Kubernetes on self-managed servers, including on virtualised infrastructure, as well as in a public cloud such as AWS, across more than one site. 

- Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes internals: the API server and etcd, scheduling, networking (such as Cilium, with mutual TLS), storage, and admission control. 

- Strong in Go or Python, with services, controllers, or tools other teams consume, not only infrastructure code. 

- Has built security into a platform: secrets management (such as Vault or OpenBao), certificate automation, short-lived credentials, and fleet patching with no visible impact on services, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set. 

- Has run a reliability programme other engineers followed: SLOs and error budgets, change control, and incident reviews that changed the system. 

- Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers. 

- Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally. 

Location & Reporting 

- Location: we are open to offer capable candidates to be based in either Australia or Singapore 

- Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering 

Employment Basis 

Full-time

Diversity 

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Post-doctorant.e en conception de catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels pour la conversion directe du CO2 en carburants liquides (H/F) – CDD 11 mois
description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : 

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : 

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

- Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

- Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

- Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

- Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES : 

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : 

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Capacités et aptitudes : 

Des qualités de synthèse, d’organisation et de communication sont également nécessaires pour mener à bien les missions de ce poste.

title: Software Engineer - B2B Lending & Payments
description:
Job Title: Software Engineer - B2B Lending & Payments 

Type: Full-time 

Location: Paris 

What about us? 

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 

The Role 

We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT.

We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. This is not a ticket-execution role. You will work with business stakeholders and clients to understand why a problem matters before deciding what to build then use agentic coding to ship the how fast and well.

Partnering with other engineers owning this domain, you will own two deeply connected responsibilities. First, crafting the best possible experience for a client going through a loan application, from the moment they submit a request to the moment financing is confirmed, every step should feel clear, fast, and trustworthy. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. Third, supporting the physical audit and due diligence workflows that allow us to maintain control over the collateral throughout the life of the loan.

You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks.

What do you need to be successful in this role? 

- 
Expert C# & .NET Engineering, mastery of the .NET ecosystem with a focus on building high-performance, distributed backend systems. You have a proven track record of shipping scalable, production-grade architectures where technical clarity and long-term maintainability are the default.

- 
Core banking & ledger logic , a strong professional background in regulated financial environments. You understand the mechanics of ledgers, loan origination, and payment execution and the cost of getting any of it wrong.

- 
Mission-critical ownership: Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end. You don't just "write code"; you analyze customer financing workflows, define rigorous technical requirements, and take full accountability for the reliability of every transaction you process.

- 
Highly effective stakeholder communication , capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders (customers, product managers) and clearly translating business objectives into prioritized engineering tasks.

- 
Practical experience leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve significantly accelerated development velocity while rigorously upholding code quality standards.

What will you find working at INFINIT? 

- Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

- Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.

- Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.

- Flexible Benefits: Access Flexible Retribution benefits through a convenient mobile app

- Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance

- Coporoate gym discount 

- Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.

- Birthday Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.

- Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 days at home.

Diversity and Inclusion 

INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.
