title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re looking for an experienced security engineer who’s independent, excited about getting things done, and ready to hit the ground running. You'll primarily be responsible for our application security, working with our product teams to work on new systems to enhance our security posture. Our customers trust us with their money, and you’ll be at the forefront of making sure we retain that trust!

This broadly scoped role will allow you to get your hands on many different types of security projects, from direct application security to helping our infrastructure team think about security for our databases. 

As we integrate AI-powered agents into our engineering and operations workflows, you'll help define and enforce the guardrails around how we use them safely. This includes securing agentic tooling against prompt injection, excessive permissions, and data exfiltration — and building the policies and technical controls to govern AI usage across the company.

Some experience with common industry certifications like ISO-27001 and PCI-DSS would be beneficial, although you won’t be expected to run or oversee audits.

Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:

- Design our agentic SIEM/SecOps pipelines to evaluate and tune AI-driven triage, alerting, and response automation

- Secure our MCP integrations against prompt injection, tool misuse, and credential exposure

- Tune and maintain code security review agents tailored to Wave's codebase, threat model, and regulatory environment

- Develop internal AI governance standards covering acceptable use, data handling, and audit requirements for LLM-powered tools

- Centralise application-level login and permissions enforcement including privileged access management

- Rework our approach to secrets management with ephemeral secrets and tighter access scopes

- Security review of our public-facing APIs

Key details 

- You can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -5 and +4) with reliable internet access.

- Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1200 to meet with coworkers.

- Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level of experience, we offer a salary of up to $185,800 USD (or local equivalent), plus a generous equity.

- We run performance reviews twice a year and award bonuses or promotions to strong performers who have been with the company for more than six months

- Major benefits:

- Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country-to-country).

- 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

- Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.

- $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

- Yearly travel to one of our African operating countries.

Requirements 

- Minimum of 7-8 years of professional experience with a minimum of 3-5 years of it spent in a security-related role

- Strong Experience with Python.

- Fluent English.

You might be a good fit if you 

- Are excited about finding the right balance between security and velocity. 

- Have opinions on how to secure agentic AI systems and want to put them into practice

- Enjoy helping other engineers understand and implement secure patterns.

- Are not afraid to take on complicated systems.

- Are excited to work on lots of different security-related work, from audits to code refactors. 

- Work to make things easier for the next engineer who will touch your code.

- Always try to improve as a programmer and colleague.

- Are interested in building governance frameworks for AI usage in a regulated financial services environment

- Have experimented with LLM-based security tooling and understand both the promise and the failure modes

- Push through hard problems without giving up.

- Have experience remediating non-conformities.

- Are interested in security-focused source code review and penetration testing.

- Have an interest in growing and mentoring a team.

About Engineering at Wave 

You'll report to the Security Team Lead and work closely with the CISO, as part of a small 4 person security team, likely rotating with many of our Product and Platform teams, depending on the project you’re working on. Each team is led by a product manager and mentored by a technical lead on the team.

AI Growth Strategists own the ongoing technical and business success of a portfolio of strategic Edwin AI customers. This is not a traditional Customer Success role and it is not a pure strategy or consulting role. The strategist sits between the customer’s technical environment, operational workflows and business priorities.

Edwin AI operates across complex enterprise environments. Customer outcomes depend on observability and monitoring data, integrations, APIs, ITSM workflows, automation, cloud and infrastructure architecture, data quality and the way each customer operates. The strategist must be able to understand that environment, diagnose what is blocking adoption, bring the right technical resources together and maintain credibility with technical stakeholders.

At the same time, the strategist must connect technical use cases and operational improvements to measurable business outcomes, executive priorities, retention and growth. You will work with technical practitioners, operational leaders and C-level stakeholders, moving comfortably between all three . 

What You’ll Own 

- Own the success of a portfolio of strategic and complex Edwin AI customers from post-implementation adoption through value realisation, maturity, advocacy and growth.

- Build a deep understanding of each customer’s architecture, observability environment, integrations, ITSM processes, operational workflows and AI use cases.

- Lead technical and operational discovery to understand customer requirements, diagnose adoption blockers and determine whether issues relate to configuration, integration, data, workflow, product capability or customer environment.

- Act as a credible technical partner to SRE, DevOps, platform, infrastructure, operations and engineering stakeholders while coordinating Support, Product and Engineering when deeper expertise is required.

- Translate technical capabilities, usage and operational outcomes into business value that is meaningful to CIOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders.

- Develop and execute customer success and growth plans with clear use cases, success measures, adoption milestones, risks and value metrics.

- Identify opportunities to expand Edwin across additional teams, workflows and use cases based on demonstrated customer outcomes and technical fit.

- Represent the Voice of the Customer: investigate the underlying problem behind feature requests, quantify impact, identify patterns across customers and build evidence-based cases for Product and Engineering.

- Proactively manage customer risk and technical escalations, maintaining clear customer communication while driving internal ownership and resolution.

- Run executive and operational customer cadences that demonstrate adoption, measurable value, risks, priorities and next steps.

- Capture repeatable use cases, technical patterns, customer outcomes and lessons learned to improve team playbooks and product strategy.

Technical Expectations 

This role does not require you to be a software engineer, but it does require genuine technical depth. You should be able to enter an unfamiliar customer environment, ask the right questions, understand how systems connect, interpret technical evidence and narrow down where a problem is likely to sit.

You should be comfortable discussing observability and monitoring concepts, APIs and integrations, ITSM workflows, cloud and infrastructure environments, automation, data flows and AI-driven operational use cases. You should know when you can progress the investigation yourself and when to bring in Support, Engineering or Product.

You will be expected to learn Edwin AI deeply and maintain enough technical credibility that customers see you as part of the solution rather than simply a relationship manager.

AI Mindset 

AI curiosity is essential. We want people who actively experiment with AI in their own work, not simply people who advise customers about it.

You should be able to demonstrate how you use AI, agents, automation or emerging tools to improve your productivity, analyse information, create workflows or solve problems. - Technical and operational blockers are identified early, accurately understood and driven to resolution.

- Customers can clearly articulate the measurable business and operational value they receive from Edwin.

- Executive sponsors remain engaged and confident in the value and direction of their Edwin investment.

- Customer risk is reduced and retention improves through proactive technical and strategic engagement.

- Expansion opportunities emerge naturally from proven use cases, adoption and demonstrated value.

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 

The Role 

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own 

- Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

- Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

- Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

- Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

- Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

- Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

- Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For 

- Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

- Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

- Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

- Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

- Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

- High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

- Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

- Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

- Can make decisions with incomplete information.

- Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

- Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

- Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For 

- People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

- PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

- Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

- People who launch features and then stop caring.

- PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location 

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week

Language 

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process 

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:

- Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's insurance comparison platform.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What they'll actually do 

- Build the system that connects to multiple insurance providers and requests quotes from all of them at once

- Design how those quotes get compared fairly and ranked for the customer

- Build the customer database and the secure audit trail required

- Set up cloud hosting, CI/CD pipeline, observability and security (encryption, secrets management)

Must-have skills 

- Strong backend development in Node.js / TypeScript (or very close equivalent, e.g. willing/able to work in it)

- Experience in relational database (PostgreSQL or similar) or non relational database (MongoDB or similar) — not just querying, but designing the schema

- Experience integrating with third-party APIs, especially handling timeouts, retries, and partial failures gracefully

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines

- Comfortable working with sensitive customer data and security best practices (encryption, access control)

Strong nice-to-haves 

- Experience in fintech, insurtech, or another regulated industry

- Experience building a "plugin" or "adapter" style system that needs to support many different external integrations over time

- Experience with Redis or similar for session/cache management

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend 

The Opportunity: 

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.

- Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.

- Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.

- Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.

- Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.

- Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.

- Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.

- Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.

- Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.

- Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.

- Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.

- Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit 

- Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.

- A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.

- A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.

- Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.

- Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.

- An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.

- Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. 

Bonus Points For 

- Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.

- Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.

- Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.

- Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.

- Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards: 

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949 - GBP 141,539 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. 

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

An overview of this role 

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

- Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.

- Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.

- Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.

- Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.

- Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.

- Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.

- Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring 

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

- Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.

- Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.

- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

- The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

- Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.

About the Role

HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.

Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.

You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.

This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You’ll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.

You’ll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer’s wider technology estate.

A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.

Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.

From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.

The role does not end at first deployment. You’ll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You’ll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Outcomes

• Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.

• Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.

• Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.

• Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.

• Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.

Lead Discovery and Solution Design

• Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.

• Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.

• Understand the customer’s existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.

• Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.

• Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.

• Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.

Build and Ship Production Solutions

• Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.

title: Senior Treasury Manager - UK
description:
Location: London
Type: Full-time 

BW ESS is seeking an experienced Senior Treasury Manager to take ownership of the Group's treasury activities across its international corporate entities, project SPVs and joint ventures.

As BW ESS continues to grow, the complexity and importance of treasury is increasing materially. This role will bring together activities currently undertaken across different parts of the organisation, establish clear ownership and controls, and build a scalable treasury capability for the Group.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can both design the right treasury framework and make sure it operates effectively day to day. We are looking for candidates with real ownership experience in complex, multi-entity, multi-currency environments, ideally gained in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities or another project- and SPV-based business.

About BW ESS 

BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain, and Sweden. It has more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with ~12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.

Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.

To find out more, visit: https://bw-ess.com/ 

The Role 

Reporting to the Director of FP&A and Treasury, you will work closely with the CFO, Strategic Finance, Portfolio FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Investments, Legal and project teams, as well as BW Group and the Group's banking counterparties.

You will be responsible for Group cash and liquidity management, credit support, FX and hedging operations, cash investment, banking and treasury facilities, treasury governance and treasury systems.

Your objective is to replace fragmented activity with a coherent Group treasury capability: giving management reliable visibility of cash, liquidity and treasury risk, ensuring cash and credit resources are deployed efficiently, strengthening controls and banking infrastructure, and building processes and systems that scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities 

- 
Cash management: own the consolidated Group cash position across corporate entities, project SPVs, joint ventures, accounts and currencies, including restricted and unrestricted cash, intercompany funding, equity contributions and distributions, and ensuring the right cash sits in the right entity, account and currency ahead of material payment obligations.

- 
Liquidity management: own the Group liquidity position and rolling forecast, consolidating inputs from Portfolio FP&A, Accounting, Investments, Strategic Finance and project teams, and providing forward-looking analysis of requirements, constraints, surpluses and funding needs across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.

- 
Credit support: own the portfolio of bank guarantees, parent-company guarantees, letters of credit and other contingent exposures, managing issuance, amendment, renewal and cancellation, and monitoring utilisation, expiries, fees, collateral and facility headroom.

- 
FX management: own the consolidated view of forecast and actual FX exposures across development, construction, operations and corporate activity, maintain the Group's FX framework, recommend hedging actions, and execute approved transactions within delegated authorities.

- 
Cash investment: manage surplus cash within approved policies and counterparty limits, optimising deposit arrangements, managing counterparty exposure and diversification, and negotiating terms to improve returns while preserving liquidity.

- 
Hedging operations: own the operational management of FX and interest-rate derivatives, including execution, confirmation, settlement, records of hedges and maturities, collateral and threshold monitoring, and treasury inputs into valuation, accounting and reporting.

- 
Banking and facilities: act as principal treasury relationship owner for cash-management and transaction banks, maintain the Group's banking architecture (accounts, mandates, signatories, access, KYC and documentation), own treasury-related facilities, and support complex funds flows for acquisitions, disposals, financings, refinancings and project financial close.

- 
Controls, policy and governance: own treasury policies, procedures, delegated authorities and the control framework, ensure transactions are authorised, documented, reconciled and auditable, monitor compliance with policy and counterparty limits, and report to senior management and governance forums.

- 
Systems and transformation: define the future treasury operating model, lead Treasury's contribution to the Group's ERP implementation, drive automation of cash visibility, forecasting, payments and bank-statement collection, and assess the role and timing of a dedicated Treasury Management System.

Required Skills and Experience 

- 
10+ years' relevant experience in corporate treasury, infrastructure, energy, banking or a closely related finance role.

- 
Demonstrable experience taking ownership of treasury activities in a complex, multi-entity, multi-currency organisation.

- 
Strong practical experience across cash and liquidity management, FX, banking, credit support and treasury controls.

- 
Experience managing senior relationships with banks and other financial counterparties.

- 
Strong understanding of treasury risk management, with the ability to translate financial exposures into practical recommendations and actions.

- 
Ability to operate effectively across multiple legal entities, jurisdictions, currencies and stakeholders.

- 
Strong judgement and the confidence to identify issues, challenge existing practice and recommend solutions to senior management.

- 
Comfortable working hands-on while building more scalable processes, controls and systems.

- 
Strong analytical capability and the ability to communicate complex treasury issues clearly and concisely.

- 
ACT, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

Preferred Experience 

- 
Energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities or another project- and SPV-based business.

- 
Treasury within a business undergoing rapid international growth.

- 
Project finance, including restricted cash, reserve accounts and project-level funding structures.

- 
Bank guarantees, letters of credit, parent-company guarantees and other project credit support.

- 
FX and interest-rate derivatives, including ISDA-governed arrangements.

- 
ERP, Treasury Management System or wider finance-transformation implementation.

- 
Cash pooling, bank connectivity, automated payments and treasury reporting.

- 
Acquisition, disposal, refinancing and complex transaction funds flows.

Why Join BW ESS? 

This is an opportunity to join a fast-moving global energy storage owner-operator at a pivotal point in its growth, and to build the Group's treasury capability from a position of genuine ownership.

If you are an experienced treasury professional who enjoys combining framework-building with hands-on delivery in an international, project-based business, we would like to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity 

BW ESS is committed to building a high-performing, inclusive team and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds

Your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

description:

OOOVATION is een in Frankrijk geboren onderneming gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en vervaardigen van op maat gemaakte medailles en trofeeën voor sportevenementen, bedrijven en grote organisaties. Met een duidelijke missie om tegen 2030 de Europese marktleider in aangepaste prijzen te worden, breidt de organisatie snel uit naar internationale markten zoals Nederland. 

Wat je gaat doen

Als Sales Representative voor de Nederlandse markt ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitbreiding en het beheer van het klantenbestand in dit specifieke segment. Je onderhoudt contacten met organisatoren van sportevenementen en bedrijven, introduceert de op maat gemaakte trofeeën en medailles, en begeleidt het volledige verkoopproces van de eerste kennismaking tot de uiteindelijke levering.

Wat de rol vraagt

Je brengt commerciële ervaring mee in een buitendienstfunctie en bezit sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om duurzame klantrelaties op te bouwen. Een resultaatgerichte aanpak en doorzettingsvermogen zijn essentieel om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen en de groeidoelstellingen te behalen.

Voldoe je niet aan elk enkel punt, maar herken je jezelf wel in het grootste deel van de profielschets? Reageer dan alsnog. 

Voor deze functie is een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands essentieel. Engels is eveneens belangrijk. Daarnaast is een basiskennis van het Frans een groot pluspunt, zodat we tijdens de opleidingsperiode gemakkelijk met elkaar kunnen communiceren.

De functie is niet noodzakelijk gevestigd in Yssingeaux, Frankrijk. Je start met een opleidingsperiode van één maand op ons hoofdkantoor in Frankrijk om onze producten, werkwijze en bedrijfscultuur te leren kennen. Na deze opleiding ga je rechtstreeks aan de slag op de Nederlandse markt.

We zoeken iemand met ambitie, ondernemerschap en leiderschapskwaliteiten. Ons doel is niet alleen om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen, maar ook om daar op termijn een lokaal team op te bouwen.

We zoeken daarom een toekomstige leider die bereid is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, een team aan te sturen en een sleutelrol te spelen in de internationale groei van OOOVATION. 

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Je ontvangt een bedrijfstelefoon en een laptop van de zaak voor de uitvoering van je werkzaamheden.

De pensioenregeling is geregeld via een bedrijfspensioenregeling.

De regeling omvat daarnaast particuliere ziektekostenverzekering, thuiswerken en opties voor remote werken.

Salaris

Het salaris bedraagt EUR 2,500–4,500 per maand.

Jouw eerste maanden bij OOOVATION

In de eerste maanden maak je je de productlijnen van op maat gemaakte awards eigen en leg je de eerste contacten binnen de Nederlandse markt. Je bouwt een pipeline op en start met het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten voor sportevenementen en organisaties.

title: Conseiller de vente
Founding lead Product Designer
description:
Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. 

We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. 

We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies.

Tasks

User Research & Discovery 

- Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.

- Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.

- Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.

- Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 

Product & Experience Design 

- What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.

- Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.

- Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.

- Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

- Work hand-in-hand with our AI product engineers so your field learnings ship as features, then get re-tested at the next pilot.

- Own the design system: components, tokens, patterns, and the copy that goes with them.

Requirements

- 4–8 years in product design, UX design, or a hybrid design-research role, ideally on complex, multi-user B2B products.

- A strong portfolio that shows both craft and thinking: we want to see how you operated, not just what shipped.

- A skilled researcher who can design a study, run it in the wild, and turn qualitative chaos into clear direction.

- Experience designing inside environments you don't control - a messaging client, an extension, an embedded product - or a clear appetite for it.

- Comfortable designing for AI-driven and adaptive experiences, where the interface has to handle uncertainty, personalization, and non-linear workflows.

- Excellent visual and interaction design skills: typography, spacing, motion, and the small details that build trust.

- Autonomous and opinionated, but you hold your opinions loosely when the evidence says otherwise.

- Genuine curiosity about AI and how people actually learn at work.

- Fluent in French and English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

- You want the ownership, equity, and career-defining challenge that only comes from being early.

- Bonus: deeply passionate about something outside of work.

Benefits

- A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.

- Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.

- Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.

- A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.

- A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

- If you care deeply about making powerful tools feel human and want to shape a product from the very beginning, this is your role. Apply now and help us build the future of learning.

- Raison is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team.

Face à la hausse des coûts de l'énergie, aux enjeux climatiques et aux évolutions réglementaires, les gestionnaires de patrimoine ont besoin d'outils fiables, mais aussi d'un accompagnement de qualité pour passer à l'action.

C'est pourquoi nous avons développé une plateforme SaaS qui permet de créer le jumeau numérique des bâtiments, de piloter les consommations énergétiques et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement réalistes, chiffrées et adaptées aux enjeux de chaque organisation.

Aujourd'hui, nous accompagnons plusieurs centaines de collectivités et d'entreprises partout en France dans leurs projets de transition énergétique.

PME lyonnaise en forte croissance, nous recherchons des collaborateurs qui souhaitent avoir un impact concret, prendre des responsabilités et contribuer à une aventure collective porteuse de sens.

Vos missions

Chez Lowit, nous accompagnons chaque jour des collectivités, des entreprises et des établissements publics dans la gestion et la transition énergétique de leur patrimoine immobilier.

Notre plateforme leur permet de mieux connaître leurs bâtiments, de piloter leurs consommations, d'anticiper les obligations réglementaires et de construire des trajectoires d'investissement cohérentes.

Parce qu'une plateforme ne crée de valeur que lorsqu'elle est pleinement appropriée par ses utilisateurs, nous accordons une place essentielle à l'accompagnement de nos clients. C'est précisément la mission de notre équipe Accompagnement Clients.

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Responsable Accompagnement Clients .

Vous deviendrez l'interlocuteur privilégié d'un portefeuille de collectivités, d'entreprises et d'établissements publics. Votre mission sera de construire une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients, de comprendre leurs enjeux et de les accompagner dans l'utilisation de nos solutions afin qu'ils en tirent le meilleur parti.

Concrètement, vous serez amené à :

- Accompagner vos clients tout au long de leur parcours chez Lowit au travers d'échanges réguliers (téléphone, visioconférences, réunions et e-mails).

- Développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux afin de leur apporter un accompagnement pertinent et personnalisé.

- Les conseiller sur les sujets liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments : réglementation, stratégie patrimoniale, performance énergétique, dispositifs d'aides, mécanismes de financement... en vous appuyant sur les experts internes lorsque cela est nécessaire.

- Réaliser ponctuellement des missions de conseil directement chez les clients afin de fiabiliser leur patrimoine, mettre à jour leurs données, construire des scénarios personnalisés et restituer des plans d'action auprès de leurs équipes de direction ou de leurs élus.

- Identifier les besoins émergents, détecter les opportunités d'accompagnement complémentaires et remonter les signaux business aux équipes concernées.

- Animer des webinaires, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer au développement de la communauté d'utilisateurs Lowit.

- Faire remonter les retours clients et les besoins fonctionnels afin de contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme et de nos services.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Projets, Produit, Commerce et nos experts techniques afin de garantir un accompagnement de grande qualité.

Ce poste est avant tout un métier de relation client, de conseil et d'accompagnement . Vous ne serez pas seul face aux problématiques techniques : vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les expertises présentes chez Lowit. En revanche, votre capacité à écouter, comprendre les enjeux de vos clients et construire avec eux une relation de confiance sera déterminante dans leur réussite… et dans la nôtre.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne qui aime construire des relations de confiance dans la durée.

Ingénieur(e) de formation ou diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 dans les domaines de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de la thermique ou de l'immobilier, vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de l'accompagnement client.

Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques de vos interlocuteurs, les accompagner dans leurs projets et leur apporter des conseils concrets. Curieux(se), à l'écoute et pédagogue, vous appréciez autant les échanges humains que les sujets techniques.

Une première expérience dans le conseil, la gestion de projet, le Customer Success ou l'accompagnement client constitue un véritable atout.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre capacité à :

- Créer une relation de confiance avec vos clients et communiquer avec aisance, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

- Comprendre les enjeux techniques, réglementaires et patrimoniaux liés à la transition énergétique des bâtiments, ou avoir l'envie de développer rapidement cette expertise.

- Faire preuve de curiosité et d'une réelle envie d'apprendre dans un secteur en constante évolution.

- Organiser votre activité et prioriser efficacement les sollicitations d'un portefeuille clients.

- Travailler en équipe et mobiliser les bonnes expertises internes lorsque la situation l'exige.

- Être à l'aise avec les outils numériques et les environnements SaaS.

Une connaissance des secteurs de l'énergie, du bâtiment, de l'immobilier ou des collectivités territoriales sera appréciée.

Enfin, si vous aimez décrocher votre téléphone pour échanger avec vos clients, créer une relation durable et les accompagner bien au-delà de la simple utilisation d'un logiciel, vous vous sentirez probablement à votre place chez Lowit.

Avantages

title: Robotics Diagnostics Engineer
description:
We are looking for a robotics diagnostics engineer who enjoys getting to the bottom of complex system issues. You will investigate unexpected behaviour in our autonomous drone-in-a-box system, combining log and code analysis with hands-on experiments on engineering systems and bench setups. Bridging support and engineering, you will turn field reports into clear explanations, actionable fix recommendations and practical mitigations.

Responsibilities

- Own investigations into system issues from new bug reports through to actionable findings, working with support to capture symptoms, operating conditions and relevant logs
- Analyze logs and source code, develop hypotheses, and reproduce and isolate failures through targeted tests on engineering systems and bench setups
- Assess issue severity with engineering, considering safety impact, system availability, affected versions and conditions, and uncertainty; escalate critical findings promptly
- Give engineering clear evidence, reproduction steps and recommendations for fixes, and help verify that proposed changes address the underlying issue
- Recommend and validate workarounds and mitigations with engineering, and give support clear guidance on their use, limitations and operational implications
Qualifications

- Experience investigating complex software failures using logs, source code and systematic root-cause analysis
- A practical approach to reproducing intermittent issues and designing experiments on engineering systems, bench setups or simulators
- Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain evidence, uncertainty, safety and availability impact, and recommended next steps to engineering and support
- Curiosity, persistence and ownership when tackling unfamiliar problems
- A degree in computer science, robotics or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Bonus Points

- Experience with drones, robotics and embedded software is a plus
100% · On-site

title: IAM Owner Governance & Plattform
description:
KNOW YOUR TALENTS .

Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist ein grosses Schweizer Unternehmen mit öffentlichem Auftrag und mehreren Tausend Mitarbeitenden im Raum Bern. Identity und Access Management läuft heute zu einem guten Teil über einen externen Partner. Das ändert sich jetzt: Die Plattform kommt zurück ins Haus, ein eigenes agiles Team entsteht, und Governance, Rollenmodell und Roadmap werden intern aufgebaut. Du kommst damit zum Zeitpunkt, an dem die grossen Linien noch gezogen werden und Deine Handschrift sichtbar bleibt. Rund 70 Prozent der Arbeit liegen in Organisation, Rahmenbedingungen und Konzeption, rund 30 Prozent in den Systemthemen.

Möchtest Du als

IAM Owner Governance & Plattform (a) 80 bis 100% 

nicht nur Teil des Ganzen sein, sondern aktiv Einfluss nehmen und mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Meine Herausforderungen

- Die IAM-Roadmap erarbeiten und mit dem verantwortlichen Bereichsleiter zur Entscheidung bringen.

- Das Business-Rollenmodell für das gesamte Unternehmen entwickeln, inklusive der passenden Solution Architecture.

- Die heute extern betreute IAM-Landschaft ins Haus zurückholen und den Aufbau des internen Teams mitgestalten.

- Die IAM-Projekte führen: Provisionierung aus dem SAP-Umfeld, On- und Offboarding externer Mitarbeitender, Neugestaltung der Rezertifizierung, Identity Provider und Verwaltung privilegierter Identitäten.

- Workshops mit den Fachbereichen planen und moderieren und dort die Anforderungen abholen, die das Rollenmodell tragen muss.

- Governance, Qualität und Compliance der Zugriffsrechte verantworten und für Audits belastbar machen.

- Fachbereiche, Systemverantwortliche und Architektur beraten und IAM in Ausbildungssequenzen so vermitteln, dass es verstanden und angewendet wird.

Meine Kompetenzen

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Identity und Access Management, von der Konzeption bis in den Betrieb.

title: SUPERSTAR - Brand Designer / Art Director
description:
International Brands is a fast-growing Swiss company in the Personal Care / FMCG space. With our brands, we bring products into tens of thousands of retail locations worldwide, from drugstores and leading retail chains to e-commerce.

We build brands that work on shelf.

Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram.

Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable.

We develop and scale brands that combine design, product and performance without compromise and win exactly where it matters most: in the market.

More than 90,000 retail locations worldwide.

And we are nowhere near our limit.

We are looking for an Art Director (100%). 

Not a traditional designer.

We are looking for the creative mind behind our entire brand powerhouse.

Someone with a deep understanding of FMCG design. Someone who knows what stops consumers at shelf, captures attention and drives sales.

Someone who takes ownership. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference.

Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.”

This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on.

We are not looking for an administrator.

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality.

Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.

Aufgaben

You own everything that moves our brands visually and creatively forward with a clear focus on FMCG performance in the market. 

- Develop and execute creative concepts across all brands with a focus on visibility, recognition and impact

- Build, sharpen and continuously evolve strong brand worlds with a consistent visual identity

- Challenge existing approaches and actively improve things instead of simply maintaining them

- Design packaging with clear FMCG logic: attention-grabbing, brand-right and built to convert at shelf

- Develop web, social and marketing assets focused on performance, not aesthetics alone

- Turn ideas into reality quickly, pragmatically and efficiently without getting stuck in endless feedback loops

- Actively leverage AI and modern tools to improve workflows, speed and creative output

- Lead projects independently from idea to finished product in market

- Manage freelancers and external partners with a high quality standard

- Work closely with the Head of Brands and the broader team

- Think beyond design with a holistic perspective from products and communication to the physical environment

Turn design into products that sell. Turn creativity into performance. 

Qualifikation

- 2–5+ years of experience in a creative role (Design, Art Direction or similar)

- Strong portfolio with real FMCG or retail work and proven execution

- Very strong Figma skills with experience in UI and web

- Experience across packaging, social media, web and print

- Deep understanding of FMCG design, retail and consumer behavior

- You challenge things and constantly look for ways to improve them

- You do not only think about aesthetics, but about impact, performance and results

- You are independent, hands-on, fast and solution-oriented

- You take initiative and actively drive projects forward

- You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions

- You use AI as a practical tool in your daily creative workflow

- German & English

What does not fit this role: 

Purely aesthetic thinking without understanding market dynamics, consumers and commercial impact

Creative profiles without genuine interest in FMCG, retail and market-driven design

Very rigid or overly process-driven ways of working

People who wait for instructions instead of taking ownership

People who love concepts but struggle with execution and speed

Benefits

Direct collaboration with the Head of Brands

Real impact on brands, products and their success in market

Fast decisions instead of endless alignment rounds

High ownership and the opportunity to truly build and shape things

If you want to build something meaningful, this is the place. 

You will not simply design.

You will build brands.

You will develop products that get noticed.

Products that stop consumers at shelf.

Products that win.

Products that people buy.

If you are someone who wants to create things that are not just beautiful, but successful, we should talk.

title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
description:
📜 Contexte 

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle 

En tant qu' Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés , vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités 

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés 
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA .
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique 
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1 .
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels 
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité 
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) .
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance 
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques .
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité 
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA) , aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation 
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil 

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent .
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX .
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO .
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements .
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique , notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

🏆 Conditions du poste 

• 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse 
• 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 % 
• 📅 Date de démarrage : flexible 

⚠️ Ce poste est ouvert aux candidat(e)s de nationalité suisse ou européenne (UE/AELE), ou titulaires d'un permis de travail valable pour la Suisse.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Why we do what we do

The mind is our window to the world. It can paint everything outside in grey or in bright colors. Whoever finds access to that window can change their perspective every day, and psychological hurdles can become chances to grow. Happiness spreads from one person to the next and across a whole society, like a quiet revolution, one mind at a time.

Who we are

Our mission inspires us and challenges us. Our skills, thoughts and ideas go into a product that reaches thousands of people, and that brings responsibility with it. The work asks for passion, integrity and the courage to try things no one has tried before.

A team full of people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world they live in. Yes, we are a hardworking team, but not for us alone, not for money or personal fame, but for the people we serve at the center of our efforts: Our team, clients, psychologists on our platform and supporters across the country.

Why this role exists

Aepsy serves three audiences, each with its own timeline. Clients need support now. Psychologists are building their practice. Employers are deciding whether to unlock access for their whole team.

This role leads performance marketing for all three: how people find Aepsy, what actually works, and what the numbers suggest we do next.

Marketing at Aepsy is a small, focused team, and every role has a clear place in it. The Creative Marketing Lead owns copy and shapes the campaigns. The Art Director builds the visual language. The Growth Performance Architect owns the measurement architecture. You work closely with all three, bringing campaigns to the right people through the right channels, finding out what worked, and helping the team decide what to keep, change or stop.

Performance with principles

Our values shape how we advertise. Privacy is non-negotiable. Anyone visiting a mental health platform deserves the highest level of privacy and data security. That means no urgency or fear in our messages, no before-and-after claims, and no targeting or retargeting based on health data or other sensitive personal information.

Sometimes this makes a number harder to reach. It also builds trust that lasts, and that trust is why people choose Aepsy. If strong performance combined with strong principles sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

- Own performance across all funnels. Clients may decide within days. Employers take longer and involve several people. Together with the colleagues closest to each audience, you define what success means for each one.

- Run paid media end to end on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. That covers structure, bidding, audiences, creative rotation, and both awareness and conversion, plus the judgement to know which of the two you’re working on.

- Read the numbers and get more out of them. The Growth Performance Architect builds the measurement setup with you. You turn it into insights the team can act on.

- Turn patterns into decisions. Why do people who considered Aepsy drop off before deciding? Does the response to a creative suggest it should run weekly rather than monthly? Answering questions like these is the core of the role.

- Shape how people find support. Search is changing fast, and new ways of discovering things are emerging. You’ll help decide how people find Aepsy when they need it most.

- Help build the team’s marketing rhythm. You’ll set up the flow for campaigns, newsletters and more, from first idea to delivery, so the whole team can rely on it.

What you bring

- Three to four years in performance marketing, including campaigns you’ve run end to end and at least one that didn’t go as planned and taught you something.

- A data-driven mindset with a real feel for brand and content.

- Confidence running Meta and Google on your own, and experience with TikTok or LinkedIn for reaching HR leads and psychologists. Bring the channels you’ve found work best.

- Judgement that weighs data together with values. The field is sensitive, Switzerland is a small multilingual market, and the mission matters.

- Fluent (Swiss) German and English. Aepsy works in four languages, German is the largest market, and most partners and HR leads communicate in German.

- A habit of noticing a step that repeats and improving it, using AI in your daily work.

Strongly preferred

- SEO and GEO basics, and curiosity about how AI search engines choose which sources to cite.

- Lifecycle marketing experience: segmentation, triggers and deliverability.

- Experience at an organisation with strong convictions, and enjoyment of doing great work within clear principles.

What we offer

- Work that matters. Every campaign you improve helps someone find support a little sooner. Your skills serve something bigger than a conversion rate.

- A team that has your back. The Creative Marketing Lead, Art Director, Growth Performance Architect and Head of Marketing are each strong in their field. You’ll never have to face a number alone.

- A strong foundation. You’ll build on a product people trust, a network of qualified psychologists, partnerships with employers and insurers, and values clear enough to make hard decisions easier.

- Room to shape things. There are three audiences, several funnels, a content area being rebuilt, and a search landscape that AI is changing. Your ideas will have impact, and you’ll see it.

- A short line to decisions. You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing and have access to leadership strategy.

- Modern tools , including AI, and the freedom to use them well.

- Time to recharge : five weeks of holiday and a mental health benefit (of course).

Together with us

We’re a young, ambitious team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs. We love conversations about the big picture and about the small details. We believe in what we do and work hard for a slightly better world. We’re also friends, parents, partners, stand-up comedians, yoga beginners and Zen monks who enjoy life.

Sleep on it. Read it again. Then take a deep breath and send us:

- Your CV and a personal cover letter . We read every letter carefully, so tell us what motivates you, why this mission matters to you, and why this role, right now.

- Whatever shows your thinking best . A short note is enough. One campaign you can explain well is worth more than a full portfolio.

In our conversation we’ll be curious about two things: a number that proved you wrong, and something you decided to stop doing.

PS: Please skip the generic, AI-generated cover letter. A few honest lines in your own words mean much more to us. The time you save is better spent in the sun, on a walk in the forest or with a friend. Life is too beautiful for impersonal cover letters :)

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transition prototypes into repeatable production.

- Create, approve, and continuously maintain assembly instructions, SOPs, test instructions, inspection instructions, and rework procedures.

- Improve assembly sequence, workstation layout, standard work, material flow, and production methods.

- Reduce rework, waiting time, manual workarounds, process variation, and cycle time.

- Apply Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S, standard work, visual management, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

- Several years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, NPI, or a similar role.

- Practical experience manufacturing and troubleshooting electronic or electromechanical products.

- Strong understanding of assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, testing, and manufacturing documentation.

- Ability to independently review drawings, tolerances, BOMs, specifications, and released engineering data.

- Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit.

- Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation.

- Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness.

- Good spoken and written English.

- EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to have : 

- Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products.

- Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems.

- Experience designing production fixtures, jigs, or test equipment.

- Experience with FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Lean, 5S, or Kaizen.
