title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD 

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

- You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

- You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

- You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

- You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

- You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

- You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

- You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

- In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

- Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

- You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

- Experience with Kubernetes.

- Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR 

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

- A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

- Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

- Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

- A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

- 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

- A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

- A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

- Collective insurance plans.

- A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

- Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

- Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more? 

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

- You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

- You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

- You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

- You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

- Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution.

Ideation and concept generation

- Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
- Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.

Stakeholder engagement and governance

- Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

Transition to implementation

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Tellent Intelligence (AI)
description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location. 

About the Role 

As a Senior Quality Engineer – Tellent Intelligence (AI) , you'll own and grow the quality of the AI-powered experiences built by our Tellent Intelligence team alongside our existing QE team. You'll help shape how we test applications powered by large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, ensuring they are reliable, safe, and deliver high-quality experiences for our customers.

You'll expand our end-to-end test coverage in Playwright and help build robust approaches for validating AI-powered systems, where quality extends beyond functional correctness. This is a hands-on, collaborative role with genuine ownership, direct impact on product development, and the opportunity to shape how we test AI at Tellent.

Your 12-Month Journey 

- During your first 3 months: You'll get to know our Tellent Intelligence domain, engineering practices, AI-powered features, and quality standards. You'll learn our testing framework and development workflow while contributing to automated, exploratory, and AI-focused testing.

- Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of quality across key AI-powered features, expand our Playwright test coverage, and work closely with engineers to validate AI behaviour, prompts, and model-driven functionality throughout development.

- After 1 year: You'll be a trusted quality partner within the Tellent Intelligence team, driving improvements to our AI testing strategy, strengthening our automation framework, and helping shape how we build reliable, safe, and responsible AI experiences across Tellent.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Work closely with fellow Quality Engineers to bring our test automation strategy to life across the Tellent Intelligence domain, taking shared ownership and continuously improving it as our platform evolves.

- Partner with developers, AI engineers, and fellow QEs to embed quality early in the development process, sharing knowledge and shaping testing practices collaboratively.

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites across frontend, backend, and AI-powered functionality.

- Develop into a product domain expert, using your understanding to identify risks early and guide quality decisions across the Tellent Intelligence domain.

- Design and execute testing strategies for AI-powered features, validating not only functional correctness but also the quality, relevance, consistency, and safety of AI-generated outputs.

- Develop approaches for testing non-deterministic systems by creating evaluation datasets, defining quality benchmarks, and identifying hallucinations, bias, regressions, and prompt-related issues as models and prompts evolve.

- Partner with engineers to validate prompt changes, AI agent behaviour, and safety guardrails, ensuring our AI behaves reliably and responsibly before reaching customers.

- Continuously improve how we evaluate AI quality by helping establish best practices, quality metrics, and testing frameworks for LLM-powered applications.

What You Bring 

- Strong QA experience: Several years of hands-on quality engineering, with senior-level ownership of testing for complex web applications.

- AI quality mindset: Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based products, conversational AI, or machine learning systems is a strong plus. If you haven't worked directly with AI before, you're excited to learn and apply quality engineering principles to this rapidly evolving space.

- E2E automation: Experience building and maintaining end-to-end test suites in Playwright.

- API & backend testing skills: Experience testing APIs and backend services.

- Balance of product and technical thinking: Equally at home discussing product behaviour and digging into technical detail.

- Understanding of AI testing challenges: Familiarity with concepts such as prompt engineering, AI agents, hallucinations, model bias, evaluation datasets, and AI safety principles is a plus.

- Analytical mindset: Comfortable defining quality expectations for systems where outputs may vary while still delivering a great user experience.

- Communication: Fluent English for daily collaboration. Polish is a plus.

What We Offer 

- Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, or Poland

- A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

- Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

- €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days

- Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks.

- 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

- Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year.

- Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling.

- €200 home office budget.

Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location. 

About Tellent 

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System ( Tellent Recruitee ), an intuitive HRIS ( Tellent HR ), and powerful Performance Management software ( Tellent Grow ).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

AI in our recruitment process 

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy , or chat with us at 

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

title: Afstudeerstage IT
description:
Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering) 
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure. 

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering) 
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt. 

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering) 
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability. 

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management) 
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant. 

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product) 
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse. 

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

- Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding ;

- Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact;

- Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host;

- De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team;

- Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS . Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”;

- Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes.

- Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding;

- Je bent woonachtig in de omgeving van Veghel.

- Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden;

- Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose and inspire thousands of drivers to transition towards electric mobility! Together with 450+ colleagues across Europe, we have the ambition to build Europe's best fast-charging network. We are active in 9 markets across Europe. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France, and the Netherlands, a testimony to our drive to offer the best charging experience to EV drivers! 

The role 

Our distinctive charging canopies create an opportunity to integrate solar panels (PV) into station design. However, this comes with a cost and certain operational complexity. We are looking for a working student to identify where solar panels create genuine legal, permitting or commercial value to help us review our strategy around this asset. 

What you will do 

- Research national, regional and local rules on solar panels regulations impacting tenders and contacts for our European markets. 

- Review permitting frameworks to determine whether solar panels create explicit scoring, compliance or approval advantages and quantify those. 

- Review existing Fastned contracts to identify where solar panels is explicitly mentioned and document the requirements around it (energy generation, maintenance etc). 

- Make a clear distinction between green energy sourcing and on-premises solar panels requirements. 

- If time allows: research the influence that solar panels have on customers choosing to charge at Fastned locations. 

Key deliverables 

- A country/region matrix showing legal requirements or clear advantages for tenders. 

- A country/region matrix showing proven advantages for permits. 

- An inventory of requirements around PVs in our existing contracts. 

- Bonus: evaluation of the value of PVs for our customers. 

Who we are looking for 

- A bachelor’s or master’s student in law, preferably energy law, environmental law, administrative law, European law, real-estate law or construction law. 

- A genuine interest in renewable energy, electric mobility, infrastructure and the energy transition. 

- Strong ability to read legislation, official guidance, tender documents and commercial contracts. 

- Excellent written English and the ability to explain complex legal topics clearly to non-lawyers. 

- A structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to source quality, citations and uncertainty. 

- Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets and the organisation of a large document set. 

- Fluency in another relevant language, such as Dutch, French, German, Spanish or Italian, is an advantage. 

- Experience with planning, permitting, public procurement, infrastructure or renewable-energy projects is an advantage. 

Join us in building a better future 

We are on a mission to make a positive impact, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. 

Our benefits package includes: 

- Enjoy a free daily vegetarian lunch provided in the office.

title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
description:
Over ons 

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie 

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden 

- Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

- Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

- Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

- Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

- Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

Jouw kwalificaties 

- Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

- Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

- Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

- Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

- Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

- Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

- In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

- Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Hoe succes eruitziet 

- Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur , en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

- Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team , door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

- Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen , door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving.

- Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden , snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

Onze werkcultuur 

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is.

Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst.

Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie.

Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken.

title: Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI

Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that's about to change completely.

We've been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving—with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We're now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we're looking for the people who want to build that future with us.

This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You'll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.

What You'll Do

You'll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:

- Designing and shipping end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work—customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more

- Crossing organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission

- Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity

- Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions

You Should Have

- 10+ years of software engineering experience ; you've built with LLMs extensively — whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn't stop yourself

- Strong product instincts : you can identify what's worth building, not just execute on a spec

- LLM fluency : agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos

- Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js—you can own a feature end to end

- An entrepreneurial drive : you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait to be told what to do

- Excellent communication : you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself

- An audacious appetite for impact : you're not here to maintain—you're here to change how global trade works

Nice to Have

- Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)

- Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications

How We Work

- We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together

- We have the latest hardware and software—including frontier AI models on day one

- We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best

- Stack : Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. For AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI APIs

Why This Role Is Special

- Your work is visible : This is a small, senior team reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. What you build gets noticed, and your ideas shape the direction

- Real stakes : thousands of containers, 112 countries, $19 billion of goods. Your agents will have immediate, measurable impact

- Full ownership : from problem definition to production deployment, it's yours

- You're early : the playbook for applied AI in enterprise logistics doesn't exist yet—you'll help write it

What's in it for you: 

- An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment 

- Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 

- Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam

- 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.

- Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 

- A defined pension contribution scheme

- Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.

Your mission

As Senior Manager – Data Engineering & Machine Learning, you’ll lead Catawiki’s established team of Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists. You’ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.

The role spans two connected disciplines. You’ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.

You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team’s work to outcomes across Catawiki.

What you'll do 

You’ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You’ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.

- Lead and develop the team: Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.

- Shape the technology strategy: Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you’ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.

What you'll bring 

You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership. You create clarity in a complex environment, empower specialists and make sound decisions across both disciplines.

Your experience will include the following. Familiarity with Catawiki’s current stack is useful, and equivalent experience with other platforms is welcome.

- Technical depth in one discipline: Deep experience designing, building and operating data-intensive systems in Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, with practical knowledge of the other.

- People leadership: Experience leading experienced engineers or ML specialists, coaching their growth and setting clear expectations.

- Architecture and systems thinking: Ability to evaluate trade-offs and guide architecture for data platforms, distributed systems and production infrastructure.

- Production ML understanding: Experience with the deployment, monitoring and operation of machine learning systems in production.

- Business and product judgement: Ability to connect technical work to business goals, make priority calls and assess outcomes.

- Relevant cloud platform experience: We run on GCP using BigQuery, Vertex AI and Kubernetes. Experience with equivalent AWS services is also relevant.

- Streaming and integration experience: Kafka, event-driven systems or modern data integration tools are useful.

- Clear communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How we work 

- You’ll lead a team of eight Data Engineers and Machine Learning specialists across Amsterdam and Lisbon.

- The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to connect data and ML capabilities to real needs.

- Specialists own implementation while you set direction, priorities and clear standards.

- The team supports production data and ML systems, and has no on-call rotation.

Where you'll be 

This is a hybrid role in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und enger Austausch mit dem Geschäftsführer.

- Technologieumfeld: Arbeite an innovativen Drohnensystemen und autonomen Technologien mit anspruchsvollen Anwendungen.

- Unternehmenskultur: Flache Strukturen, offene Kommunikation und ein motiviertes Team mit hoher Technikaffinität.

- Mobiles Arbeiten: Homeoffice ist nach Absprache möglich, sofern es die jeweiligen Aufgaben und die operative Situation erlauben.

- Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Ausstattung mit aktueller Hard und Software sowie kurze Wege zwischen Entwicklung, Produktion und Projektmanagement.

- Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander.

- Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Projekt & Operations Managerübernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte, Ressourcen und interne Abläufe zuverlässig ineinandergreifen.

- Operative Steuerung: Koordination des täglichen Geschäftsbetriebs über die Bereiche Werkstatt, Produktion, Entwicklung, Projektkoordination, Beschaffung und Flugbetrieb hinweg.

- Projektkoordination: Steuerung mehrerer paralleler Entwicklungs-, Liefer- und Forschungsprojekte hinsichtlich Terminen, Ressourcen, Qualität und Budgets.

- Priorisierung: Wöchentliche Abstimmung der Projektprioritäten, Kapazitäten und Ressourcen sowie eigenständige Lösung entstehender Konflikte.

- Produktion: Koordination von Produktion, Ausgangsprüfung und Auslieferung der Drohnensysteme.

- Prozesse: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung effizienter operativer Abläufe in Bereichen wie Projektplanung, Aufgabensteuerung, Einkauf, Lager und Qualitätsmanagement.

- Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Abstimmung mit den Verantwortlichen aus Entwicklung, Produktion, Projektmanagement und weiteren internen Bereichen.

- Projektmanagement: Unterstützung und Koordination bei Kundenprojekten, Lieferungen, Abnahmen und weiteren operativen Vorhaben.

- Compliance: Koordination relevanter Themen rund um Exportkontrolle, Zoll und erforderliche Dokumentationen.

- Geschäftsführung: Entlastung des Geschäftsführers im operativen Tagesgeschäft, damit dieser sich stärker auf Strategie, Technologie und Schlüsselkunden konzentrieren kann.

- Weiterentwicklung: Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Vorantreiben von Maßnahmen zur Skalierung und Automatisierung der operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil als Projekt & Operations Manager

- Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Operations Management oder in einer vergleichbaren verantwortungsvollen Position mit technischen Produkten.

- Ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

- Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten, die Entwicklung und Fertigung verbinden, idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit eigener Produktion.

- Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in einer verantwortungsvollen Rolle mit Führungsbezug oder der Steuerung von Teams und Projekten.

- Erfahrung in der Koordination mehrerer paralleler Projekte sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Termine, Ressourcen, Budgets und Prioritäten.

- Technisches Verständnis für mechatronische Systeme und die Fähigkeit, sich auf Augenhöhe mit Konstruktion, Elektronik und Software auszutauschen.

- Eine ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und die Fähigkeit, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen, selbstständig Lösungen zu entwickeln und Themen ohne lange Abstimmungswege voranzutreiben.

- Eine ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und die Bereitschaft, in einem kleinen Unternehmen ohne große Stabstrukturen selbst Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort sowie gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kunden, Testkampagnen, Übungen und Messen. Diese Einsätze halten sich in der Regel in Grenzen und finden maximal etwa einmal pro Monat statt.

Nice to have

- Erfahrung im Verteidigungs-, Marine-, Luftfahrt- oder Behördenumfeld.

- Kenntnisse im Bereich Drohnen oder unbemannte Systeme.

- Erfahrung mit Exportkontrolle, BAFA oder Zoll.

- Erfahrung mit Kleinserienfertigung.

- Kenntnisse in Jira oder vergleichbaren Projektmanagementsystemen.

- Kaufmännisches Verständnis für Kalkulation, Projektcontrolling oder Liquiditätsplanung.

- Erfahrung beim Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem Wachstumsunternehmen oder Start-Up.

- Projektmanagement Zertifizierung wie PMP, IPMA oder PRINCE2.

Deine Perspektive als Projekt & Operations Manager

Die Position bietet die Möglichkeit, sich langfristig zu einer zentralen Führungsrolle im Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Geschäftsführer zusammen, hast einen umfassenden Einblick in die verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche und kannst die operativen Strukturen maßgeblich mitgestalten.

Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung?

Wenn du technische Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern die operativen Abläufe eines innovativen Technologieunternehmens aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf.

title: Sales Manager Wholesale Fund Sales (w/m/d)
description:
Sales Manager – Wholesale Fund Sales / Asset Management (w/m/d) 

Bad Homburg (Hybrid) – 75.000 € – 110.000 € Jahresgehalt, 30 Urlaubstage 

WICHTIG: Wer keine regelmäßige Reisebereitschaft und Präsenz in Bad Homburg (mind. 3 Tage/Woche) mitbringen kann, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht einfach irgendeinen Vertriebskanal bedienen. Du willst aktiv neue Banken und Private Banker gewinnen und den Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb eigenverantwortlich ausbauen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Produktpräsentation. Hier geht es um den Aufbau eines bundesweiten Partnernetzwerks, um 30 % Jahresziel‑Bonus und um die Gestaltung deiner Vertriebsstrategie mit einem Top‑Verdienst von 75‑110 k €.

Unser Kunde 

Der Kunde ist ein unabhängiger Multi‑Asset‑Manager mit rund 65 Mrd. € verwalteten Vermögen und über 280 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten in Deutschland, Schweiz, Luxemburg und Österreich. Das Unternehmen bietet maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen über alle wesentlichen Assetklassen und zählt zu den führenden Anbietern im deutschsprachigen Raum. Es legt Wert auf Verantwortung, Authentizität, Integrität und Exzellenz.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist 

- Hoher Verdienst: attraktives Fixum plus erfolgsabhängiger Bonus

- Eigenverantwortung: du gestaltest den bundesweiten Ausbau des Vertriebskanals

- Netzwerkaufbau: nutze und erweitere dein bestehendes Partnernetz zu Sparkassen, Genossenschafts‑ und Privatbanken

- Investment‑ und Due‑Diligence‑Fokus: du bist maßgeblich an Fondsselektion, Manager‑Bewertung und Portfolio‑Konstruktion beteiligt

- Hybrid Flexibilität: 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche, flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit

- Premium Benefits: Firmenwagen, monatliche Shopping‑Card, umfangreiche Weiterbildungsprogramme

Aufgaben

- Proaktive Neukundenakquise: Zielunternehmen identifizieren, erste Kontakte herstellen, Abschlüsse generieren

- Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen: langfristige Beratung zu Fund‑Solutions und Strategien

- Erstellung und Optimierung von Präsentationen, Angeboten und Vertriebs‑Materialien

- Enge Abstimmung mit Produktentwicklung, Portfoliomanagement und Marketing

- Markt‑ und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Trends erkennen und Vertriebsstrategie anpassen

- Pflege des CRM‑Systems und Erstellung von Vertriebsreports

- Mitwirken bei Roadshows, Events und strategischen Team‑Sessions

- Durchführung von Fonds‑Due‑Diligence, Manager‑Bewertung und Erstellung von Investmentempfehlungen

- Monitoring von institutionellen Fonds und Mitgestaltung von Portfoliostrategien

Qualifikation

- 3–8 Jahre Erfahrung im Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertrieb mit starkem Fokus auf Private Credit bzw. Private Markets Fund Investing, inkl. Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence und Bewertung.

- Nachweisliche Erfahrung im institutionellen Fondsmonitoring, in der Portfoliokonstruktion und in der Erstellung von Investmentempfehlungen.

- Solides Business‑Development‑ und Strategie‑Profil im Finanzumfeld, inkl. erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Investoren, Unternehmen und Senior Stakeholdern.

- Sehr gute Kommunikations‑, Präsentations‑ und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.

- Abgeschlossene Bankausbildung (vorzugsweise Sparkasse/Genossenschaft) oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1) und gutes Englisch (B2).

- Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen bundesweiten Dienstreisen und Präsenz in Bad Homburg (ca. 3 Tage/Woche).

Was hier nicht funktioniert 

- Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker.

- Fehlende Erfahrung im Private‑Credit‑ oder Private‑Markets‑Umfeld – kein Fit.

- Keine nachweisbare Fondsselektion, Manager‑Due‑Diligence oder Bewertung von Fondsmanagern – keine Basis für Erfolg.

- Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse – Kommunikation auf Verhandlungs‑Level unmöglich.

- „Lone Wolf“ – nicht kompatibel mit teamorientierter Kultur.

Benefits

- Attraktives Vergütungspaket: 75–110 k € Fixum + Bonus, Firmenwagen‑/E‑Auto‑Budget.

- Monatliche Shopping‑Card im Wert von 50 €.

- 30 Urlaubstage und flexible Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- 2 Home‑Office‑Tage pro Woche (Hybrid‑Modell).

- Weiterbildungs‑ und Karriereprogramme (Inhouse, extern, Leadership, High‑Potential).

- Kita‑Zuschuss, Deutschlandticket, Dienstrad‑Leasing, Gesundheits‑ & Sportangebote.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht 

- Du bist verantwortlich für den bundesweiten Ausbau des Vertriebskanals – sichtbarer Impact von Tag 1.

- Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochspezialisierten Fund‑Solutions‑Team mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung.

- Du profitierst von einem unabhängigen Multi‑Asset‑Manager mit 65 Mrd. € AUM und erstklassigen Produktlösungen.

- Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Sales Manager – Wholesale Fund Sales (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Key Account Manager Fondsvertrieb, Wholesale Sales Manager, Fund Sales Manager, Institutional Sales Manager, Relationship Manager Wholesale, Vertriebsmanager Drittfond heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du über 3–8 Jahre nachweisliche Wholesale‑Fund‑Vertriebserfahrung und ein starkes Netzwerk zu Sparkassen/Genossenschaftsbanken verfügst.

Noch Fragen? 

08106 – 39 80 370

title: Co-Founder*in: Business Development, B2B-Marketing & Hospitality (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns: Wer ist Modumat und was treibt uns an?

Wir sind Modumat – und wir gestalten die Zukunft der smarten, nachhaltigen Warenausgabe!

Klassische Verkaufsautomaten sind oft klobig, unflexibel, wartungsintensiv und verbrauchen unnötig viele Ressourcen. Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengestützt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag – von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels.

Hinter Modumat stehen wir: Raphael und Frederik , zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp läuft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde jüngst mit der Dörte-Wörner-Innovationsförderung ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Frühjahr unseren Master abschließen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das EXIST-Gründerstipendium , um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen.

Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied – die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive für unser Gründungsteam! 

Was du bei Modumat bewegst

Als kaufmännische und kommunikative Säule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und Märkten, die sie brauchen:

- Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation: Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere Lösung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (über LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen).

- Fokus Hospitality & Gästeerlebnis: Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungsträger*innen der Branche Lösungen, die Gäste und Hotelteams gleichermaßen begeistern.

- Partnerschaften & Kundenbeziehungen: Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu B2B-Partnern auf (Hotels, Coworking-Spaces, moderne Gastgeber) und gewinnst gemeinsam mit uns erste Pilotpartner sowie Letters of Intent (LOIs) für den EXIST-Antrag.

- Geschäftsmodell & EXIST-Antrag: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Teil unserer Gründungsreise – von der Markt- und Zielgruppenanalyse über faire Pricing-Modelle bis hin zur Finanzplanung im Rahmen des EXIST-Stipendiums.

- Webpräsenz & Außenwirkung: Du gestaltest unseren Auftritt (Website, Pitch Decks, Kommunikationsmaterial) so, dass aus innovativer Technik verständliche, einladende Mehrwerte für unsere Kund*innen werden.

Was du mitbringst

(Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben – viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!) 

- Studienhintergrund: Du studierst BWL, Marketing, Hospitality-/Tourismus-Management, International Business, Kommunikationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach (kurz vor dem Masterabschluss oder bereits abgeschlossen).

- Gespür für Hospitality & Service (großes Plus): Du kennst die Dynamik der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie (z. B. Personalmangel, Gästebedürfnisse, 24/7-Service) aus Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder deinem Netzwerk – oder du hast große Lust, diese spannende Branche mit sinnstiftender Technologie zu unterstützen.

- Kommunikationsstärke & Kundenfokus: Du hörst Kund*innen genau zu, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und kannst komplexe Produkte empathisch, klar und überzeugend vermitteln.

- Offenheit für Tech & moderne KI-Tools: Du musst keine Zeile Code schreiben. Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig auf digitale Innovationen bist und moderne KI-Tools (wie ChatGPT, Canva/Design-Tools oder Recherche-Tools) gerne nutzt, um dir den Arbeitsalltag kreativ und effizient zu erleichtern.

- Gestaltungswille & Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, schätzt aber genauso den engen Austausch im Team, um gemeinsam Ideen weiterzuentwickeln.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Gründen auf echter Augenhöhe: Du kommst nicht als Angestellte*r dazu, sondern als vollwertige Co-Founderin bzw. vollwertiger Co-Founder. Wir treffen Entscheidungen gemeinsam und legen großen Wert auf eine offene, wertschätzende und transparente Teamkultur.

- Finanzielle Sicherheit & faire Anteile: Über das EXIST-Gründerstipendium erhältst du nach Bewilligung bis zu 2.500 €/Monat , um dich ohne finanziellen Druck auf das Startup zu konzentrieren. Zudem erhältst du eine faire, transparente Beteiligung (Equity) an der gemeinsamen GmbH.

- Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: Ob in unserem schönen, ausgestatteten Projektraum an der h_da (Gebäude D22) oder flexibel im Homeoffice – wir richten unsere Arbeitsweise so ein, dass sie zu unserem Leben passt.

- Ein verlässliches Fundament: Du startest nicht bei null. Technik, Prototyp und erste Förderungen sind bereits da – und wir (Raphael & Frederik) stehen dir als verlässliche, hilfsbereite Partner bei allen technischen Fragen jederzeit den Rücken frei.

- Starkes Netzwerk & Mentoring: Rundum-Support durch YUBIZZ!, das Startup-Zentrum der Hochschule Darmstadt (Workshops, Gründungsförderung & Ökosystem), sowie individuelles Mentoring und Sparring durch unseren Gründercoach Prof. Dr. Michael von Rüden.

Hast du Lust, Modumat gemeinsam mit uns groß zu machen?

Wenn du dich in vielen Punkten wiederfindest – auch wenn vielleicht nicht jeder einzelne Haken zu 100 % sitzt –, freuen wir uns riesig, von dir zu hören!

Schreib uns einfach eine kurze, unkomplizierte Nachricht mit deinem LinkedIn-Profil oder Lebenslauf. Lass uns gerne ganz entspannt bei einem Kaffee oder Tee an der Hochschule Darmstadt oder via Video-Call kennenlernen und schauen, ob die Chemie stimmt!

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend 

The Opportunity: 

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.

- Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.

- Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.

- Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.

- Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.

- Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.

- Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.

- Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.

- Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.

- Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.

- Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.

- Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit 

- Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.

- A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.

- A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.

- Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.

- Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.

- An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.

- Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. 

Bonus Points For 

- Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.

- Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.

- Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.

- Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.

- Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571 - EUR 149,485 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. 

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. 

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

title: Staff Solutions Architect, AI Subject Matter Expert
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

An overview of this role 

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do 

- Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.

- Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.

- Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.

- Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.

- Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.

- Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.

- Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.

- Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring 

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

- Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.

- Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.

- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

- The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

- Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.

- Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

About the team 

We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Flexible Paid Time Off

title: Director, European Government Operations
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB 

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS 

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO 

- Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market

- Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives

- Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies

- Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs

- Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs

- Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab’s interests are represented and understood

- Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business

- Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company’s visibility and credibility

- Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them

- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor’s degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field

- 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe

- Professional fluency in German and English

- Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions

- Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring

- Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes

- Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment

- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE 

- Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors

- Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies

- Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting

- Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem

- Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas .

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. 

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: 

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here . 

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. 

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at 

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY: 

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.
