title: Sales Director, ITS, Europe
description:
Who is Seyond? 

Seyond™ is a global leader in high fidelity LiDAR solutions, powering the future of mobility across ADAS, ITS, Robotics, Stationary and Off-Road industries. Seyond delivers a dynamic portfolio of robust, high resolution LiDAR sensors, perception software, and the Seyond ITS Management Platform (SIMPL). Founded in Silicon Valley with a global footprint, Seyond is dedicated to the highest quality engineering and manufacturing, and unwavering commitment to our customers.

About Seyond ITS 

Drawing on deep expertise in precision sensing and edge intelligence, Seyond offers a robust portfolio of LiDAR sensors, perception software, and transportation analytics solutions designed to improve roadway safety, traffic operations, and multimodal mobility.

This portfolio includes the SIMPL™ ITS Management Platform, Seyond’s LiDAR-based detection solution for smart intersections and highways. SIMPL operates as a distinct business unit with dedicated pricing and go-to-market authority across two verticals: urban intersection management and interurban highway, tunnel, and tolling detection.

Sales Director, ITS, Europe 

Location: Remote, Europe

Team: Seyond ITS — SIMPL, our LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection platform

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL 

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role 

We are looking for a Sales Director, ITS, Europe to build and lead SIMPL’s sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will sit above SIMPL’s country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do 

- Build and lead SIMPL’s European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.

- Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.

- Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.

- Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.

- Own the European sales pipeline and forecast in HubSpot, maintaining accurate deal ownership, stage progression, and close-date discipline.

- Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.

- Partner with SIMPL’s European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.

- Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.

- Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For 

- 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.

- A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine “hunter,” not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.

- Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.

- Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.

- Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.

- Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.

- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have 

- An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.

- Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.

- Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation 

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

WAS DICH ERWARTET: 

- Beratung und Lösungsfindung : Als Solution Architect Professional Services ist deine Hauptaufgabe, Unternehmen mit Projektgeschäft oder Dienstleistern dabei zu unterstützen, die richtigen IT-Lösungen für ihre spezifischen Geschäftsanforderungen zu finden. Auf Grundlage dieser Informationen entwickelst du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und Konzepte, die größtenteils auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 basieren.

- AI-Driven Consulting: Du nutzt aktiv modernste KI-Tools (z. B. Microsoft Copilot, generative KI für die Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Agenten)

- Implementierung und Führung: Nachdem du die passende Lösung unter Berücksichtigung des Best-Practice-Ansatz mit dem Projekt-Team konzipiert hast, bist du für die fachliche Implementierung und Integration von Microsoft Dynamics 365 in die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur des Kunden verantwortlich. Du steuerst und führst dabei das HSO-Projekt-Team sowie den Kunden, um das Projekt erfolgreich und in guter Qualität umzusetzen.

- Technisches Know-how: Du bist auf dem neuesten Stand der Entwicklungen in Microsoft Dynamics 365 und insbesondere im Rahmen der Abwicklung von Projektgeschäften und Dienstleistern. Dies erfordert kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und die Fähigkeit, technisches Wissen in geschäftliche Lösungen umzusetzen.

- Tools und Methoden@HSO: Du wendest unsere ausgezeichnete Projektmethodik HSO Excellerate™ in klassischer oder agiler Ausprägung an und nutzt Microsoft Dynamics 365 Unified Operations sowie weitere moderne Produkte wie die Microsoft Power Platform.

WAS DICH AUSZEICHNET: 

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem MINT-Studiengang, BWL, Supply-Chain-Management und relevante Erfahrung der Prozesse im Projektgeschäft und/oder Dienstleistungsgeschäft sowie die Abwicklung dieser Prozesse im Bereich Dynamics 365

- Du bringst Projekterfahrung in der Beratung von Geschäftsanwendungen als Inhouse-Consultant und/oder für ein Beratungshaus mit

- Branchenkenntnisse aus dem Bereich Dienstleistungen/Professional Services oder aus dem Bereich Anlagenbau/Engineer-to-Order

- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

- Du hast eine hohe Leidenschaft für modernste KI-Tools (z. B. Microsoft Copilot, generative KI und KI-gestützte Agenten)

- Sehr gute Deutsch– und gute Englischkenntnisse

- Projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft

WAS WIR BIETEN: 

- Result Orientation: Du arbeitest bei einem der global größten und erfolgreichsten Microsoft-Partner im Bereich Microsoft Dynamics 365 und treibst damit die digitale Transformation voran

- Self Determination: Bei uns steht die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe im Mittelpunkt - mit deinen Ideen und Erfahrungen kannst du dich bei uns einbringen, eigenständig agieren und damit den Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten

- Team Spirit: Da Menschen bei HSO den Unterschied machen, kannst du dich auf eine unterstützende, vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen

- Learning & Growth: Wir werden dich mit Trainingsangeboten durch unsere hauseigene HSO Academy und externe Schulungspartner in Kombination mit einem individuellen Karrierepfad fördern

- Onboarding@HSO: Wir heißen dich in unserem Office in Böblingen willkommen - du startest deine ersten Onboarding-Tage bei uns vor Ort, um dich mit unserer Unternehmenskultur, unseren Prozessen und Tools vertraut zu machen 

- Hybrid Workforce: Ohne festgeschriebene Kernarbeitszeit hast du die Möglichkeit flexibel bei Kunden vor Ort, aus deinem Homeoffice oder in unseren Offices in Böblingen, München, Nürnberg oder Chemnitz zu arbeiten

- Appreciation: Ein attraktives Gehaltsmodell inklusive 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterangebote, Bikeleasing, Gesundheitsförderung durch EGYM Wellpass, Geburtstagsgutscheine und außergewöhnliche Events runden dein HSO-Feel-Good-Paket ab

- Workation : Wir möchten unseren Mitarbeitenden mehr Flexibilität und Freiräume bieten, damit sie ihre Work-Life-Balance aktiv gestalten können. Daher hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr unter Einhaltung der rechtlichen Bedingungen aus der EU, dem EWR und der Schweiz zu arbeiten

HSO fördert aktiv Vielfalt und Inklusion. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter. Wir setzen uns für ein diskriminierungsfreies Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem Chancengleichheit gefördert und die Unterschiedlichkeit jedes Einzelnen respektiert und wertgeschätzt wird.

title: Sr. Principal Engineer, MEMS Development
description:
About SiTime 

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com .

Job Summary 

Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. As a Principal MEMS Development Engineer, you will use your technical and creative problem-solving skills to push forward MEMS technology and engineer resonators for SiTime’s next-generation timing products. 

Responsibilities: 

- Define and lead the development of new MEMS technologies, enhance performance or manufacturability of existing devices, improve measurement or simulation infrastructure, both through team effort and personal technical contributions

- Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects. 

- Advise management of challenges, impact, recommendations.

- Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products.

- Contribute technical ideas for SiTime’s technical roadmap, by working with Marketing and Executive teams in defining next-generation products based on new technologies. 

- Interface with local and overseas vendors, establish new partnerships favorable to SiTime business

- Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and Program Management to deliver scalable, predictable development execution.

- Adapt to evolving business needs and lead critical initiatives as required.

It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. 

Qualifications & Requirements: 

- Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent

- 10+ years of industry experience in MEMS or specialty sensor development; 15+ years is preferred. Experience with MEMS timing is strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success leading and delivering complex MEMS development programs.

- Hands‑on technical credibility across MEMS design, fabrication, characterization, and modeling.

- Strong technical and business judgment with the ability to innovate, design experiments, and interpret complex data.

- Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python).

- Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills

- Working knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment, and methods

- Passion for execution excellence, ownership, delivering exceptional results

Compensation Range: 

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Learn More about SiTime: Review the Get to Know SiTime section of our career page to explore our culture, values, and what makes us unique.

title: Senior Accountant – Finance Operations (m/f/d)
description:
About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures — and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place — cost center, account, country — and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers — or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors — ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality — you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders — short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

About EggAI

Agentic workforces are inevitable. Making them work is our mission. 

EggAI is building the engineering methods, operating models, and reusable technology to deploy agentic workforces with the quality and control required for sustained business impact.

Working closely with enterprise clients, we design, implement and operate agentic systems that evolve from augmenting individual tasks to autonomously executing end-to-end processes alongside people—resilient, controlled, and scalable. We begin with the client problem, select the technical approach that best serves it, and remain accountable through deployment, adoption, and operations. Each deployment strengthens the next by turning production learning into reusable capability.

We are an experienced, international team working across Europe. We set high standards, take ownership of outcomes, and value clear thinking, candid feedback, and the ability to turn ideas into tangible results.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems. 

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions? 

We will explore EvalOps : the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

- Regression suites : How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

- Coverage estimation : How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

- Live monitoring : Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

- Eval analysis : How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

- Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

- Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

- Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

- Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

- Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

- Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar 
Driving question 
Possible EvalOps focus 

Product 
What should we build? 
Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions. 

Engineering 
How should we build it? 
Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling. 

Data Science 
How do we know it works? 
Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty. 

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

- Problem obsession . A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

- Initiative and follow-through . You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

- Evidence of making things work . Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

- Independent judgment . You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

- Generosity in collaboration . You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

- You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

- You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

- You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

- Industry insight . Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

- Meaningful ownership . Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

- Close mentorship . Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

- Room to develop . Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

- A say in the Lab’s direction . Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

- Competitive compensation , including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why . Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

- You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

- You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

- You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to develop and productionize modern computer vision and visual language capabilities across major intelligence and public safety projects. You will work directly with state-of-the-art and open-source computer vision models, visual language models (VLMs), and related AI technologies — training, evaluating, fine-tuning, and optimizing them for real-world use cases.

You will work on challenging problems including object recognition and identification, image and document understanding, geospatial data, satellite imagery, and large-scale visual data. The role combines model development with practical engineering: building data pipelines and scrapers, running experiments, and taking promising approaches into reliable systems.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone with exceptional learning ability, strong analytical and engineering skills, and a genuine interest in applying AI to complex problems in the intelligence and public safety domain. You will work closely with other engineers, technical leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn ideas and experiments into impactful capabilities.

What you’ll do

- Develop, train, evaluate, and fine-tune computer vision and visual language models.

- Work on object recognition, detection, classification, and identification.

- Build data pipelines, scrapers, and workflows for large-scale visual and geospatial datasets.

- Experiment with state-of-the-art and open-source models and turn promising approaches into reliable systems.

- Work with satellite imagery, geospatial data, sensors, and other visual intelligence sources.

- Take ownership of experimental projects and rapidly explore new ideas and technologies.

- Collaborate closely with other engineers and technical leadership on key initiatives.

- Travel every 2–4 weeks for architecture reviews and team events.

About you

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field; with excellent grade record from a leading university (Master's preferred).

- Strong academic record and excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Strong programming skills and experience developing or fine-tuning AI/ML models.

- Experience with computer vision, VLMs, image understanding, or related ML applications. 

- Strong interest in data, analytics, and data pipelines.

- Exceptional ability and motivation to learn new technologies and domains quickly.

- Self-directed, hands-on, and comfortable working without close day-to-day management.

- Strong team player with clear and honest communication.

- Excellent German language skills. 

- Eligible to work full-time in Germany and willing to undergo the required security clearance and background checks.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience with georeferencing, satellite imagery, remote sensing, OpenStreetMap, or photogrammetry.

- Experience with large-scale data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, or ML deployment.

- Experience with sensors such as drones, antennas, or cameras.

- Background in computer vision research, e.g. Fraunhofer IGD or similar. 

- Knowledge of Russian or Ukrainian language.

- Interest or experience in military, intelligence, defense, or public safety domains. 

What we offer

- Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

- Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

- Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.

- Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.

- Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.

- A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.

- Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.

- A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

title: Account Executive - Munich
description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. 

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Account Executive- DACH (Munich) 

Why We Have This Role 

Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us target new business, specifically focused on selling into the DACH market. This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients. In this role, you will work to identify and pursue new corporate clients in the DACH market. We are a high energy, fast paced global team determined to support the continuing growth in Qualtrics. This role offers the opportunity to work with numerous departments and collaborate with many different stakeholders.

How You’ll Find Success 

- You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions that are applicable to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them

- You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.

- You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business

- You bring together internal resources that enable you to be successful sales professional

- You will navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take

How You’ll Grow 

- By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a team that dares to pursue groundbreaking experiences.

- Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.

- As a member of our global sales organization, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory in the DACH market. Your responsibilities will include developing a robust strategy designed to drive demand and revenue.

- We encourage big-picture thinking and foster an environment that embraces innovation and creativity. You will build relationships with multiple decision makers in an account and educate them on the value of Qualtrics.

Things You’ll Do 

- Your focus is acquiring new business and selling the Qualtrics Platform to accounts from champions all the way up to C-level

- You will consult with prospects and clients on their strategic business goals

- Developing account plans for a set list of target accounts, from power maps to demand generation to closing plans

- You will establish, handle, and manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies

- Strategizing internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc on how we will create demand in the account & drive senior engagement

- Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' solution offerings and the competitive landscape to assist in figuring out win-based proposals and pricing

- Working together is key and you will leverage support from your own Sales team, sales operations, legal, customer success, finance and more to help your customers

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume 

- Fluency in both English and German

- Technology/Software sales experience required

- Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.

- Experience in building qualified pipeline and identifying new opportunities

- Ability to be curious and ask questions to clients to determine opportunities for impact

- You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.

- You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business

- You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals

What You Should Know About This Team 

- Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.

- As a Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.

- The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.

- Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.

- We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits 

- Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing

- Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other

- At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team

The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic. 

​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws: Family & Medical Leave Act , Equal Opportunity Employment , Employee Polygraph Protection Act 

Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

title: Senior Specialist (m/w/d) GxP Training
description:
Simtra ist ein erstklassiges Auftragsentwicklungs- & Herstellungsunternehmen, welches seit über 65 Jahren in Zusammenarbeit mit mehr als 60 internationalen Kunden weltweit sterile, injizierbare Arzneimittel auf den Markt bringt. Unser Hauptaugenmerk liegt hierbei auf der Herstellung von Krebstherapeutika. Mit der Unterstützung von über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an unseren drei Standorten in Bloomington, Indiana, USA; Parsippany, New Jersey, USA und Halle/Westfalen, Deutschland , können wir unseren Kunden ein breites Portfolio von Verabreichungssystemen anbieten, darunter vorgefüllte Spritzen, flüssige/lyophilisierte Fläschchen, Verdünnungsmittel für die Rekonstitution, mit Pulver gefüllte Fläschchen und sterile Kristallisation. Neben der GMP-Herstellung bieten wir auch weitere Dienstleistungen an, darunter Unterstützung bei der Formulierung und Entwicklung, Gefriertrocknungsoptimierung, globale regulatorische Unterstützung sowie Sekundärverpackung. 

Simtra wird aus vielseitigen Teams in verschiedenen Bereichen gebildet! Werden Sie ein Teil des Teams und unterstützen Sie zukünftig dabei Patienten weltweit lebensverändernde Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen. 

Wir produzieren in unserem Werk in Halle/Westfalen Arzneimittel zur Therapie verschiedener Krebs- und anderer lebensbedrohenden Erkrankungen. 

Für unser Team suchen wir Sie als Senior Specialist (m/w/d) GxP Training. 

In dieser Position unterstützen Sie die Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung der GxP-Schulungsaktivitäten am Standort und stellen die Einhaltung regulatorischer Trainingsanforderungen sicher. Dies bedeutet im Einzelnen: 

- Pflege und Verwaltung von Schulungsdokumentationen, Nachweisen und Trainingsunterlagen 

- Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung von Audits und Inspektionen durch Bereitstellung relevanter Schulungsnachweise 

- Pflege und Aktualisierung von Ausbildungsplänen sowie Trainingsmatrizen 

- Zusammenarbeit mit LMS-Administratoren zur Sicherstellung korrekter Trainingszuweisungen und Schulungsdaten 

- Bearbeitung trainingsbezogener Anfragen im LMS, z. B. Zuweisungen, Nachweise oder Fristverlängerungen 

- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Trainingsprozessen und Schulungsunterlagen 

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Quality, Fachabteilungen und weiteren Stakeholdern zur Sicherstellung der Compliance 

Sie bringen mit: 

- 
Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder Studium in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Quality, Human Resources, Education oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

- 
2 bis 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem GxP-regulierten Umfeld

- 
Gute Kenntnisse der GxP-Trainingsanforderungen sowie von rollenbasierten Schulungskonzepten

- 
Erfahrung in der Pflege von Trainingsmatrizen, Curricula oder Schulungsprogrammen

- 
Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Audits und Inspektionen von Vorteil

- 
Strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit hoher Detailgenauigkeit

- 
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

- 
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Learning-Management-Systemen (LMS) sowie Kenntnisse von ALCOA+ und Datenintegritätsprinzipien

Das bieten wir Ihnen: 

- Faire tarifgebundene Vergütung inkl. Sozialleistungen wie ein 13. Tarifgehalt, Urlaubsgeld , betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine zusätzliche Pflegeversicherung

- Hauseigene moderne Kantine mit attraktiver Be­zu­schus­sung

- 30 Tage Urlaub plus Sonderurlaub

- Wochenarbeitszeit von 37,5 Stunden 

- Job-Rad Leasing

- Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Rabatte für Mitarbeitende bei zahlreichen bekannten Marken

- Gute Verkehrsanbindung und kostenlose Mitarbeitendenparkplätze 

- Berufsbedingter Umzug? Wir unterstützen finanziell im Rahmen unserer Umzugskostenpauschale

- Kostenlose Betriebssportarten z.B. Badminton, Fußball und Fitnesskurse

Engagierten und begabten Menschen bieten wir interessante Chancen in allen Phasen des Berufslebens. Geschlecht, Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexuelle Orientierung und Beeinträchtigungen spielen dabei keine Rolle - im Gegenteil: Wir fördern Vielfalt und glauben, dass Diversität eine Bereicherung darstellt.

Wir freuen uns über die Zusendung der Unterlagen zu Ihrem bisherigen beruflichen Werdegang direkt über unser Online-System.

title: Regional Sales Director (m/w/d) – Vertriebsleitung Region West
description:
Du willst kein Gebiet verwalten. Du willst ein Team bauen, das auch ohne dich verkauft. Als Regional Sales Director führst du acht Leute im Außendienst zwischen Ulm, Augsburg und München, mit KI-basierter Lead-Priorisierung, eigenem Forecast und Key-Account-Verhandlungen, die du selbst zum Abschluss bringst.

Standort: Großraum Köln – du arbeitest eigenständig in der Region West im Außendienst, mit rund 60 % Kundenterminen und 40 % Homeoffice, langfristig eher 50/50.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine. 

Deine Aufgaben

- Du baust das regionale Field-Sales-Team weiter auf und etablierst eine Leistungskultur, in der jede Person ihre Zahlen selbst verantwortet

- Du entwickelst eine hybride Vertriebsstrategie, die digitale Tools mit persönlicher Kundennähe verbindet

- Du implementierst klar strukturierte Vertriebsprozesse mit definierten Rollen

- Du setzt die regionalen Wachstumsziele um und führst strategische Key-Account-Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss

title: Flight Software Architect
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities 

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you 

- Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

- Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

- System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

- Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

- Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

- Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

- Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following: 

- 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems.

- Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems , ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications.

- Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software , operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems.

- Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies.

- A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment.

- Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints.

- The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions.

- Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures.

- Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

- A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space.

You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
description:
About this role 

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role 

- Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

- Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

- Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

- Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

- Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

- Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

- Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

- The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need 

- 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

- Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

- Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

- Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

- Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

- A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

- Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

- Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

- Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer 

- Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

- Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

- A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

- Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

- Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

- Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

- We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

title: Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist - UK
description:
Mission 

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

The Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist makes the Neko member experience standard real on the ground. You deliver our member experience training to teams across the business, primarily clinic teams and centralised support teams, and you run the quality assurance activity that tells us whether the standard is actually landing in practice.

This is a delivery role at the heart of a live culture change programme. You will facilitate training that shifts mindset, not just process, run experience audits against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, and turn what you see into coaching and improvement. As markets scale, you keep the standard consistent across every site and cohort, and rising over time.

You own the coordination and logistics that keep training and quality assurance running: scheduling sessions and audits, and organising the people, spaces and materials each one needs. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months 

- Stage 1 and Stage 2 member experience training delivered consistently to every new clinic cohort in your market, with 30-day reviews showing the mindset shift is landing, not just attendance being logged. (Member First, always) 

- A regular quality assurance rhythm is live: experience audits across clinic and support teams, scored consistently against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, with clear findings shared back to the teams and their leads. (Impact, not activity) 

- Audit insight turned into action: recurring friction points named early and at least two concrete experience improvements implemented with clinic and support leads. (Optimistic truth-seeking) 

- Support team training built out and delivered alongside clinic training, so centralised member support holds the same standard as the clinic floor. (Chase 10X, not 10%) 

- The ongoing learning ecosystem running smoothly, including the monthly AI role play and quiz, with completion tracked and shared with Clinic Leads as a coaching tool, not a performance measure. (Tech-enabled, human-centred) 

- A training and audit calendar owned end to end: sessions scheduled around clinic rotas and cohort timing, facilitators, rooms, materials and joining details arranged, and audits planned on a set cadence so every site and team is covered without gaps. (Impact, not activity) 

Minimum Requirements 

- 3+ years in training delivery, learning and development, hospitality, or member and customer experience, ideally in a high-touch service, hospitality, or premium retail environment.

- A confident facilitator, comfortable leading a room of clinicians and operators and holding attention and energy across a full-day session.

- Hands-on experience running quality assurance or experience audits, mystery shopping, or service standard reviews, with the ability to score consistently and give feedback that changes behaviour.

- A sharp eye for service detail and what separates a good experience from an exceptional one, drawn from service design and hospitality thinking rather than process alone.

- Organised and self-directed, able to run a training and audit calendar across multiple sites and cohorts without dropping the standard.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the credibility to influence teams and leads who do not report to you.

- Willingness to travel regularly between clinic sites, and occasionally between markets.

- Experience supporting a multi-site clinic, hospitality, or retail rollout as it scales.

- Experience with digital learning tools, an LMS, or AI-enabled training and assessment.

- Confident with everyday workplace tools, including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, to build training materials, track audits and report findings.

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

title: Senior Security Engineering Consultant
description:
Nomios’ mission is to build a secure and connected future. Organisations across the globe depend on us to help secure and connect their digital infrastructures.

As part of our continued UK growth, we are expanding our Professional Services capability and seeking a Security Engineering Consultant to deliver specialist security engineering and operations consultancy across our customer base.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Security Operations domain, focused on helping customers improve and automate their SOC functions, tooling, and detection capabilities. You will work across a range of technologies and engagements, from SOAR and SIEM implementation through to vulnerability management, exposure management, and process automation.

Your role as Senior Security Engineering Consultant 

The Security Engineering Consultant role sits within the Security Operations Team, working directly with the Nomios SOC Engineering team.

This is a senior, customer-facing Professional Services role within our Security Engineering function, focused on detection engineering and automation. You will lead the design and delivery of detection and response capabilities across SIEM, XDR and SOAR platforms. This includes building detection rules, developing automations, and creating operational playbooks that support effective SOC outcomes.

A key aspect of the role is ownership of the detection as code approach, ensuring detections and automations are developed, structured and delivered in a consistent and scalable way. Working directly with customers, you will define detection strategies, design use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, and guide improvements in visibility, coverage and response maturity. You will work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams, supplementing them with specialist expertise in detection engineering and automation, rather than focusing on platform deployment itself. 

The role combines hands-on engineering with advisory responsibilities, with a clear focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and enabling customers to operate and evolve their detection capabilities.

Responsibilities 

Key responsibilities of the role include:

Deliver 

- Design and deliver detection rulesets across SIEM and XDR platforms

- Develop and tune detection logic using KQL or equivalent query languages

- Design detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and real-world attack techniques

- Map customer log sources to detection use cases to assess coverage and identify gaps

- Design and implement SOAR automations, integrations and response workflows

- Develop and document customer incident response playbooks aligned to detection outputs

- Translate threat intelligence and operational learnings into improved detections and automations

- Deliver detection as code pipelines, including structured use case development and versioning approaches

- Produce clear technical and customer-facing deliverables, including detection strategies, use case catalogues and coverage assessments

Collaborate 

- Work directly with customers as a trusted technical consultant

- Lead workshops covering detection engineering, use case design and SOC maturity

- Guide customers on improving detection coverage and aligning to MITRE ATT&CK

- Clearly explain detection strategies, gaps and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Work closely with platform onboarding and engineering teams to ensure smooth integration of delivered detections and automations

- Support SOC teams by ensuring delivered outputs are practical, usable and aligned to operational workflows

Improve 

- Contribute to the continuous evolution of detection use cases, playbooks and automation patterns

- Support development of reusable detection content and delivery standards

- Contribute to lab work, testing and validation of detection approaches

- Identify gaps in telemetry, logging and enrichment, and provide recommendations to strengthen detection outcomes

Job Requirements 

At Nomios, we’re looking for #smartpeople who bring #highenergy, curiosity and a strong desire to learn. If you're someone who enjoys working collaboratively, communicates clearly and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Required Skills and Experience 

- Strong hands-on experience with SIEM engineering, including developing and tuning detection rules, with Microsoft Sentinel preferred 

- Experience writing detection logic using KQL or similar query languages 

- Proven experience designing and implementing SOAR automations and playbooks such as Logic Apps, Cortex XSOAR or similar 

- Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell or similar, including working with APIs 

- Experience designing detection use cases aligned to MITRE ATT&CK 

- Strong understanding of detection coverage and how log sources map to the attack lifecycle

- Experience with XDR or EDR platforms such as Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or Cortex 

- Understanding of cloud environments, particularly Azure, and associated security telemetry 

- Experience working in customer-facing or consultancy roles 

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

Technical Competencies 

- SIEM and XDR platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Palo Alto XSIAM or XDR, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne 

- SOAR development, including automation and playbook design using platforms such as Palo Alto XSOAR or similar 

- Scripting and integration using Python, PowerShell or similar, including API-driven automation 

- Detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, including use case design, ruleset development and coverage assessment 

- Log source mapping and normalisation to support detection use cases 

- Network Detection and Response technologies such as Vectra AI, Corelight or similar 

- Cloud security and telemetry, particularly within Azure environments 

- Threat intelligence integration and enrichment to support detection and response 

- Development of customer playbooks and response workflows aligned to SOC operations 

- General awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-driven security tooling and their application within detection and response

Job Specifics 

- Location: This is a hybrid role, while the role is primarily remote, typically 70% to 80% percent of the time, there will be a requirement to travel to customer sites and attend the Basingstoke office as required to support delivery, workshops and engagements.

(free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!).

- Hours are full-time: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm. There is no on-call requirement for this position.

Why would you choose to come and work with us? 

You will be part of a collaborative engineering environment, working across a wide range of customer environments and technologies. The role offers exposure to real-world threats, modern detection approaches, and the opportunity to shape how Security Operations capabilities are designed and delivered.

Nomios offers a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and industry-leading benefits, along with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how we and our customers build and run Security Operations.

Contractors will not have these benefits.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

At Dionach by Nomios, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and we're committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.

We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and are committed to providing a supportive and accessible environment for all our employees. If you require accommodations during the application process, let us know, and we'll work to meet your needs.

Screening Requirements 

This role requires successful completion of the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening prior to commencement. BPSS is a government-mandated pre-employment check that includes identity verification, right to work, employment history, and criminal record screening.

- Translate complex technical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Stay updated with the latest security trends, tools, and techniques.

- Focus on your development by attaining industry recognised certifications.

- Be available for occasional on-call duties and on-site client engagements, as needed.

What We're Looking For 

- Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CREST CRT, CREST CCT, OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, or equivalent level.

- Experience: At least two years in penetration testing, covering network, web, and internal tests and customer engagements.

- Tools: Proficiency with tools like Burpsuite Pro, Nessus, and other industry standards.

- Communication: Strong verbal and written skills for stakeholder management, collaboration and report writing.

- Independence: Ability to work solo or as part of a team on penetration tests.

- Eligibility: Right to work in the UK and eligibility for security clearance.

Key Attributes 

- Analytical thinker with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to work effectively under pressure and adapt to rapidly changing threat landscapes.

- Commitment to maintaining the highest ethical and professional standards.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Issuing
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

The Role 

Checkout.com are actively looking for an enthusiastic and talented Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in London to drive rapid growth for our revolutionary Card Issuing solution. We need a high-achieving individual to help global enterprises launch modern card programs—from virtual cards for travel intermediaries to physical cards for BNPL.

If you are a driven and focused salesperson with a proven track record of selling cutting edge issuing solutions in a high-growth and competitive environment, this is the role for you. In return, on top of a tremendous working environment, we offer you an unrivalled uncapped recurring commissions plan.

Reporting to the Director, the Senior Sales Manager will handle multiple sales cycles, always ensuring a high conversion rate and outperforming the sales targets.

Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects. The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

- Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals.

- Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques.

- Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert.

- Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer.

- Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

- Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends

- Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information

What We’re Looking For 

- Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing.

- Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners.

- AI & Productivity: Proficient in leveraging AI-powered sales tools to augment prospecting and analyze deal intelligence to accelerate the sales cycle.

- Technical Passion: Tech-savvy with a passion for how technology is transforming finance.

- Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products.

- Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation techniques, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

- Tools: Knowledge of Salesforce and a highly organized approach to prioritizing shifting workloads.

Additional Information 

Bring all of you to work 

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com 

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
